========== FILE: .github/workflows/ci.yml ==========
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: poker
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: pokerpass
          POSTGRES_DB: poker
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports:
          - 6379:6379

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm -w apps/server run typecheck

      - name: Test engine
        run: npm -w packages/poker-engine run test

      - name: Test server
        run: npm -w apps/server run test

      - name: Test frontend
        run: npm -w apps/mini-app run test

      - name: Install Playwright
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: E2E tests
        run: npx playwright test
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://poker:pokerpass@localhost:5432/poker
          REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379
          JWT_SECRET: test_secret

      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: coverage
          path: |
            packages/poker-engine/coverage/
            apps/server/coverage/
            apps/mini-app/coverage/

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/App.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import { auth } from './stores/auth';
  import { initRealtime } from './lib/realtime';
  import { adminRequested } from './stores/admin';
  import Login from './routes/Login.svelte';
  import Home from './routes/Home.svelte';
  import Tables from './routes/Tables.svelte';
  import Wallet from './routes/Wallet.svelte';
  import Profile from './routes/Profile.svelte';
  import Table from './routes/Table.svelte';
  import Leaderboard from './routes/Leaderboard.svelte';
  import Events from './routes/Events.svelte';
  import Tournaments from './routes/Tournaments.svelte';
  import TournamentDetail from './routes/TournamentDetail.svelte';
  import Achievements from './routes/Achievements.svelte';
  import Shop from './routes/Shop.svelte';
  import Notifications from './routes/Notifications.svelte';
  import Settings from './routes/Settings.svelte';
  import HelpCenter from './routes/HelpCenter.svelte';
  import Admin from './routes/Admin.svelte';
  import MyTournaments from './routes/MyTournaments.svelte';
  import SideNav from './components/SideNav.svelte';
  import BottomNav from './components/BottomNav.svelte';
  import ToastStack from './components/ToastStack.svelte';
  import AdminPrompt from './components/AdminPrompt.svelte';
  import Splash from './routes/Splash.svelte';

  type Page =
    | 'home' | 'tables' | 'wallet' | 'profile' | 'table' | 'leaderboard'
    | 'events' | 'tournaments' | 'tournament-detail' | 'achievements'
    | 'my-tournaments' | 'shop' | 'notifications' | 'settings' | 'help' | 'admin';

  let currentPage: Page = 'home';
  let activeTableId = 1;
  let activeTournamentId: number | null = null;
  let tableSource: 'cash' | 'tournament' = 'cash';
  let tablesVariant: string = 'all';
  let tablesMode: 'all' | 'free' | 'real' = 'all';
  let tablesKey = 0;

  $: hideNav =
    currentPage === 'table' ||
    currentPage === 'achievements' ||
    currentPage === 'my-tournaments' ||
    currentPage === 'shop' ||
    currentPage === 'notifications' ||
    currentPage === 'settings' ||
    currentPage === 'help' ||
    currentPage === 'admin';

  let splashElapsed = false;
  $: forceSplash = $auth.loading || !splashElapsed;

  onMount(async () => {
    setTimeout(() => { splashElapsed = true; }, 3000);
    await auth.init();
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (token) initRealtime(token);

    // ============ SECRET ADMIN (after password prompt) ============
    adminRequested.subscribe((v) => {
      if (v) {
        currentPage = 'admin';
        adminRequested.set(false);
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
      }
    });
  });

  function navigate(page: Page) {
    currentPage = page;
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }

  function openTable(id: number) {
    activeTableId = id;
    tableSource = 'cash';
    currentPage = 'table';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }

  function openTournamentTable(tournamentId: number, virtualTableId: number) {
    activeTournamentId = tournamentId;
    activeTableId = virtualTableId;
    tableSource = 'tournament';
    currentPage = 'table';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }

  function openTournament(id: number) {
    activeTournamentId = id;
    currentPage = 'tournament-detail';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }

  function backFromTable() {
    if (tableSource === 'tournament' && activeTournamentId) {
      currentPage = 'tournament-detail';
    } else {
      navigate('tables');
    }
  }

  function quickSeat(variant: string, mode: 'free' | 'real') {
    tablesVariant = variant;
    tablesMode = mode;
    tablesKey++;
    currentPage = 'tables';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }
</script>

<!-- ============ OUTER BACKGROUND ============ -->
<div
  class="fixed inset-0 -z-10"
  style="background: #05080f;"
>
  <div
    class="absolute inset-0"
    style="
      background-image: url('/bg-pattern.png');
      background-size: 600px auto;
      background-repeat: repeat;
      opacity: 0.35;
    "
  ></div>
  <div
    class="absolute inset-0"
    style="
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -10%, rgba(30,58,138,0.5) 0%, transparent 55%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 110%, rgba(212,175,55,0.12) 0%, transparent 55%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7,14,27,0.55) 0%, rgba(5,8,15,0.9) 100%);
    "
  ></div>
</div>

{#if forceSplash}
  <Splash />
{:else if !$auth.user}
  <Login />
{:else}
  <div class="relative flex" style="min-height: 100dvh;">
    {#if !hideNav}
      <SideNav current={currentPage as any} onNavigate={navigate} />
    {/if}

    <main
      class="flex-1 relative"
      class:with-side={!hideNav}
      style="min-height: 100dvh;"
    >
            <div
        class="mx-auto"
        style="max-width: {currentPage === 'table' ? '100%' : '520px'};"
      >
        {#if currentPage === 'home'}
          <Home onNavigate={navigate} onQuickSeat={quickSeat} onOpenTable={openTable} />
        {:else if currentPage === 'tables'}
          {#key tablesKey}
            <Tables initialVariant={tablesVariant} initialMode={tablesMode} onOpenTable={openTable} />
          {/key}
        {:else if currentPage === 'wallet'}
          <Wallet />
        {:else if currentPage === 'profile'}
          <Profile onNavigate={navigate} />
        {:else if currentPage === 'table'}
          <Table tableId={activeTableId} onBack={backFromTable} />
        {:else if currentPage === 'leaderboard'}
          <Leaderboard />
        {:else if currentPage === 'events'}
          <Events onNavigate={navigate} />
        {:else if currentPage === 'tournaments'}
          <Tournaments onOpenTournament={openTournament} />
        {:else if currentPage === 'tournament-detail' && activeTournamentId !== null}
          <TournamentDetail
            tournamentId={activeTournamentId}
            onBack={() => navigate('tournaments')}
            onOpenTable={openTournamentTable}
          />
        {:else if currentPage === 'achievements'}
          <Achievements onBack={() => navigate('profile')} />
        {:else if currentPage === 'my-tournaments'}
          <MyTournaments onBack={() => navigate('profile')} />
        {:else if currentPage === 'shop'}
          <Shop onBack={() => navigate('profile')} />
        {:else if currentPage === 'notifications'}
          <Notifications onBack={() => navigate('home')} />
        {:else if currentPage === 'settings'}
          <Settings onBack={() => navigate('profile')} />
        {:else if currentPage === 'help'}
          <HelpCenter onBack={() => navigate('profile')} />
        {:else if currentPage === 'admin'}
          <Admin onBack={() => navigate('profile')} />
        {/if}
      </div>
    </main>

    {#if !hideNav}
      <BottomNav current={currentPage as any} onNavigate={navigate} />
    {/if}

    <ToastStack />
  </div>
{/if}

<!-- Admin password prompt (global) -->
<AdminPrompt />

<script lang="ts">
  import { adminPromptOpen, confirmAdmin, cancelAdmin } from '../stores/admin';

  let secret = '';
  let busy = false;
  let error = '';
  let shake = false;

  $: if ($adminPromptOpen) {
    secret = '';
    error = '';
    busy = false;
    shake = false;
  }

  async function tryLogin() {
    if (!secret || busy) return;
    busy = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/stats', {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${secret}`,
        },
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        localStorage.setItem('admin_secret', secret);
        confirmAdmin();
      } else {
        error = '╪▒┘à╪▓ ╪د╪┤╪ز╪ذ╪د┘ç ╪د╪│╪ز';
        shake = true;
        setTimeout(() => (shake = false), 500);
        secret = '';
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message || 'network error';
    } finally {
      busy = false;
    }
  }

  function close() {
    if (busy) return;
    cancelAdmin();
  }
</script>

{#if $adminPromptOpen}

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/components/ChatModal.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import Avatar from './Avatar.svelte';
  import type { TableSocketIO, ChatMessage } from '../lib/socket';

  export let open: boolean = false;
  export let myUserId: number | null = null;
  export let myAvatarId: string = 'spade';
  export let socket: TableSocketIO | null = null;
  export let onClose: () => void = () => {};

  let messages: ChatMessage[] = [];
  let inputText = '';
  let messagesEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let sending = false;
  let errorMsg = '';
  let lastSendAt = 0;

  const QUICK_EMOJIS = ['≡اّï', '≡اء', '≡ا¤ح', '≡اّ', '≡اءé', '≡اء▒', '≡اّ', '≡اجّ', '≡اجإ', '≡ا'];

  const QUICK_CHAT = [
    'Nice hand!',
    'gg',
    'well played',
    'nice river',
    'ouch',
    'all in?',
    'call',
    'fold',
  ];

  function scrollToBottom() {
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (messagesEl) messagesEl.scrollTop = messagesEl.scrollHeight;
    }, 30);
  }

  async function sendMessage(text: string, isEmoji = false) {
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    if (!trimmed || sending || !socket) return;

    // client-side cooldown feedback
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastSendAt < 1200) {
      errorMsg = 'Slow downظخ';
      setTimeout(() => (errorMsg = ''), 1500);
      return;
    }
    lastSendAt = now;

    sending = true;
    errorMsg = '';
    try {
      const res = await socket.sendChat(trimmed, isEmoji);
      if (!res.ok) {
        if (res.code === 'RATE_LIMIT') errorMsg = 'Slow downظخ';
        else if (res.code === 'TOO_LONG') errorMsg = 'Message too long';
        else if (res.code === 'NOT_IN_TABLE') errorMsg = 'Not seated at table';
        else errorMsg = 'Failed to send';
        setTimeout(() => (errorMsg = ''), 2000);
      } else {
        inputText = '';
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      errorMsg = e.message;
      setTimeout(() => (errorMsg = ''), 2000);
    } finally {
      sending = false;
    }
  }

  function sendEmoji(emoji: string) {
    sendMessage(emoji, true);
  }

  function handleKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMessage(inputText);
    }
  }

  // ===== Subscribe to socket events =====
  let unsub: (() => void) | null = null;

  $: if (socket && open && !unsub) {
    unsub = socket.on((evt) => {
      if (evt.type === 'chat') {
        messages = [...messages, evt.message];
        scrollToBottom();
      }
    });

    // Load history
    socket.requestChatHistory().then((hist) => {
      if (hist.length > 0) {
        messages = hist;
        scrollToBottom();
      }
    });
  }

  $: if (!open && unsub) {
    unsub();
    unsub = null;
    // clear on close
    setTimeout(() => { messages = []; }, 200);
  }

  $: if (open) {
    setTimeout(scrollToBottom, 100);
  }

  onDestroy(() => {
    if (unsub) unsub();
  });
</script>

{#if open}
  <button
    aria-label="Close"
    class="fixed inset-0 z-[95] cursor-default"

  ></button>

  <div

          >
            <svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
              <path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <p class="text-white/50 text-sm font-bold">No messages yet</p>
          <p class="text-white/35 text-[11px] mt-1">Say hi to your opponents</p>
        </div>
      {:else}
        {#each messages as m (m.id)}
          {@const isMine = m.userId === myUserId}
          <div class="flex items-start gap-2.5 {isMine ? 'flex-row-reverse' : ''}">
            <div
              class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full overflow-hidden shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center"

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/components/HandHistoryModal.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import PlayingCard from './PlayingCard.svelte';

  export let open: boolean = false;
  export let onClose: () => void = () => {};
  export let onReplay: (handId: number) => void = () => {};

  let view: 'list' | 'detail' = 'list';
  let hands: any[] = [];
  let selectedHand: any = null;
  let selectedDetail: any = null;
  let loading = false;
  let error = '';
  let activeTab: 'summary' | 'actions' | 'results' = 'summary';

  let searchQuery = '';
  let filter: 'all' | 'won' | 'lost' | 'real' | 'free' = 'all';

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function suitChar(s: string): 'ظآب' | 'ظآح' | 'ظآخ' | 'ظآث' {
    if (s === 's') return 'ظآب';
    if (s === 'h') return 'ظآح';
    if (s === 'd') return 'ظآخ';
    return 'ظآث';
  }

  function fmtDate(iso: string): string {
    try {
      const d = new Date(iso);
      return d.toLocaleString('en-US', {
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
      });
    } catch {
      return iso;
    }
  }

  // Winners from hand
  $: myUserId = null; // will be filled from localStorage token or prop

  async function loadHands() {
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.getRecentHands(50);
      if (res.ok && res.data) hands = res.data.hands || [];
      else error = res.error || 'failed';
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  async function openHand(h: any) {
    selectedHand = h;
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.getHandDetail(h.id);
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        selectedDetail = res.data;
        view = 'detail';
        activeTab = 'summary';
      } else error = res.error || 'failed';
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  function goBack() {
    view = 'list';
    selectedHand = null;
    selectedDetail = null;
  }

  $: if (open && hands.length === 0 && !loading) loadHands();

  $: filteredHands = hands.filter((h) => {
    if (searchQuery) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      const hay = `${h.handNo} ${h.tableName} ${h.variant}`.toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
    }
    if (filter === 'won') return h.isWin === true;
    if (filter === 'lost') return h.isWin === false;
    if (filter === 'real') return h.mode === 'real';
    if (filter === 'free') return h.mode === 'free';
    return true;
  });

  $: actionsByStreet = (() => {
    const result: Record<string, any[]> = {
      preflop: [],
      flop: [],
      turn: [],
      river: [],
    };
    if (!selectedDetail?.events) return result;

    let street = 'preflop';
    for (const evt of selectedDetail.events) {
      const phase = evt.payload?.phase;
      if (phase === 'flop') street = 'flop';
      else if (phase === 'turn') street = 'turn';
      else if (phase === 'river') street = 'river';
      if (evt.type === 'ACTION_TAKEN') result[street].push(evt.payload);
    }
    return result;
  })();
</script>

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/components/HandReplayModal.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import PlayingCard from './PlayingCard.svelte';
  import Avatar from './Avatar.svelte';

  export let open: boolean = false;
  export let handId: number | null = null;
  export let onClose: () => void = () => {};

  let loading = false;
  let error = '';
  let replay: any = null;
  let states: any[] = [];
  let step = 0;
  let playing = false;
  let speed = 1;
  let playInterval: any = null;

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function suitChar(s: string): 'ظآب' | 'ظآح' | 'ظآخ' | 'ظآث' {
    if (s === 's') return 'ظآب';
    if (s === 'h') return 'ظآح';
    if (s === 'd') return 'ظآخ';
    return 'ظآث';
  }

  const ANGLE_MAP: Record<number, number[]> = {
    2: [90, 270],
    3: [90, 210, 330],
    4: [90, 180, 270, 0],
    5: [90, 162, 234, 306, 18],
    6: [90, 150, 210, 270, 330, 30],
    7: [90, 141, 193, 244, 296, 347, 38],
    8: [90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315, 0, 45],
    9: [90, 130, 170, 210, 250, 290, 330, 10, 50],
  };

  function seatPos(idx: number, total: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    const angles = ANGLE_MAP[total] || ANGLE_MAP[6];
    const deg = angles[idx] ?? 90;
    const rad = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
    const rx = total === 2 ? 36 : 42;
    const ry = total === 2 ? 32 : 34;
    return { x: 50 + Math.cos(rad) * rx, y: 50 + Math.sin(rad) * ry };
  }

  async function load() {
    if (!handId) return;
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.getHandReplay(handId);
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        replay = res.data;
        states = buildStates(res.data);
        step = 0;
      } else {
        error = res.error || 'failed';
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  function buildStates(data: any): any[] {
    const { hand, initialSnapshot, events } = data;
    const initialPlayers = (initialSnapshot?.players || []).map((p: any) => ({
      seat: p.seat,
      userId: p.userId,
      displayName: p.displayName,
      stack: Number(p.stack || 0),
      betThisStreet: 0,
      folded: false,
      allIn: false,
    }));

    const blinds = initialSnapshot?.blinds || { sb: 0, bb: 0, ante: 0 };
    const initialPot =
      (blinds.sb || 0) + (blinds.bb || 0) + (blinds.ante || 0) * initialPlayers.length;

    const result: any[] = [];
    const currentState = {
      phase: 'preflop',
      pot: initialPot,
      community: [] as any[],
      players: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(initialPlayers)),
      lastAction: null,
    };
    result.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentState)));

    let prevPhase = 'preflop';
    const allCommunity = hand?.community_cards || [];

    for (const evt of events) {
      const payload = evt.payload || {};
      const phase = payload.phase;

      if (phase && phase !== prevPhase) {
        for (const p of currentState.players) p.betThisStreet = 0;
        prevPhase = phase;
        currentState.phase = phase;
      }

      if (payload.pot !== undefined) currentState.pot = Number(payload.pot);

      const seat = Number(payload.seat);
      const player = currentState.players.find((p: any) => p.seat === seat);
      if (player) {
        const action = String(payload.action || '').toUpperCase();
        const amount = Number(payload.amount || 0);

        if (action === 'FOLD') {
          player.folded = true;
        } else if (action === 'CALL') {
          const cost = Math.min(amount || player.betThisStreet, player.stack);
          player.stack = Math.max(0, player.stack - cost);
          player.betThisStreet += cost;
          if (player.stack === 0) player.allIn = true;
        } else if (action === 'RAISE' || action === 'BET') {
          const prev = player.betThisStreet;
          const increment = Math.max(0, amount - prev);
          player.stack = Math.max(0, player.stack - increment);
          player.betThisStreet = amount;
          if (player.stack === 0) player.allIn = true;
        }
      }

      if (currentState.phase === 'flop') {
        currentState.community = allCommunity.slice(0, 3);
      } else if (currentState.phase === 'turn') {
        currentState.community = allCommunity.slice(0, 4);
      } else if (currentState.phase === 'river' || currentState.phase === 'showdown') {
        currentState.community = allCommunity.slice(0, 5);
      }

      currentState.lastAction = {
        seat,
        action: payload.action,
        amount: payload.amount || 0,
        displayName: player?.displayName || `Seat ${seat}`,
      };

      result.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentState)));
    }

    const winners = hand?.winner_seats || [];
    const lastState = result[result.length - 1];
    for (const p of lastState.players) {
      if (winners.includes(p.seat)) (p as any).isWinner = true;
    }

    return result;
  }

  function togglePlay() {
    if (playing) {
      stopPlay();
      playing = false;
    } else {
      if (step >= states.length - 1) step = 0;
      playing = true;
      startPlay();
    }
  }

  function startPlay() {
    stopPlay();
    const interval = 1500 / speed;
    playInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (step < states.length - 1) {
        step++;
      } else {
        stopPlay();
        playing = false;
      }
    }, interval);
  }

  function stopPlay() {
    if (playInterval) {
      clearInterval(playInterval);
      playInterval = null;
    }
  }

  function skip(delta: number) {
    step = Math.max(0, Math.min(states.length - 1, step + delta));
  }

  function setSpeed(s: number) {
    speed = s;
    if (playing) startPlay();
  }

  function goToStreet(street: string) {
    const idx = states.findIndex((s: any) => s.phase === street);
    if (idx >= 0) step = idx;
  }

  $: if (open && handId && !loading && (!replay || replay.hand?.id !== handId)) {
    load();
  }

  $: if (!open) {
    stopPlay();
    playing = false;
  }

  $: currentState = states[step] || null;
  $: currentStreet = currentState?.phase || 'preflop';
  $: progressPct = states.length > 1 ? (step / (states.length - 1)) * 100 : 0;

  onDestroy(() => stopPlay());
</script>

      <!-- Table -->
      <div class="flex-1 relative" style="min-height: 0;">

  // Animation props

  export let folding: boolean = false;

  const sizes = {
    xs: { w: 26, h: 36 },
    sm: { w: 34, h: 48 },
    md: { w: 50, h: 70 },
    lg: { w: 64, h: 90 },
    xl: { w: 82, h: 115 },
  };
  $: s = sizes[size];
  $: radius = Math.max(3, s.w * 0.09);

  const RANK_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
    A: '1', K: 'king', Q: 'queen', J: 'jack',
    T: '10', '10': '10',
    '9': '9', '8': '8', '7': '7', '6': '6',
    '5': '5', '4': '4', '3': '3', '2': '2',
  };
  const SUIT_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
    'ظآب': 'spade', 'ظآح': 'heart', 'ظآخ': 'diamond', 'ظآث': 'club',
  };

  $: rankFile = RANK_MAP[rank.toUpperCase()] ?? '1';
  $: suitFile = SUIT_MAP[suit] ?? 'spade';
  $: activeThemeId = themeOverride ?? $cardTheme;
  $: theme = CARD_THEMES.find((t) => t.id === activeThemeId) ?? CARD_THEMES[0];
  $: cardSrc = theme.path.replace('{suit}', suitFile).replace('{rank}', rankFile);

  $: backSrc =
    activeThemeId === 'luxury' ? '/card-back-classic.png' :
    activeThemeId === 'neon' ? '/card-back-dark.png' :
    '/card-back-royal.png';

  $: cssFilter = theme.filter && theme.filter !== 'none' ? theme.filter : 'none';
  $: frontFilter = dim ? 'brightness(0.55) saturate(0.5)' : cssFilter;

  // ---- Deal animation (once on mount) ----
  let playDeal = false;
  onMount(() => {
    if (dealFrom !== 'none') {
      playDeal = true;
      const totalMs = (dealDelay + 0.7) * 1000;
      const t = setTimeout(() => { playDeal = false; }, totalMs);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }
  });

  $: dealClass = playDeal ? 'deal-in' : '';
  $: foldClass = folding ? 'fold-out' : '';
  $: dealVars =
    dealFrom === 'top-left' ? '--dx: -50vw; --dy: -40vh;' :
    dealFrom === 'top-right' ? '--dx: 50vw; --dy: -40vh;' :
    dealFrom === 'top' ? '--dx: 0vw; --dy: -40vh;' :
    '';
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';

  export let amount: number = 0;
  export let size: number = 28;
  export let maxStack: number = 5;

  // Animation props
  export let animate: boolean = true;   // pop-in on mount
  export let pulse: boolean = false;    // winner highlight
  export let collecting: boolean = false; // fly-away when pot collected

  const DENOMS = [
    { value: 1,       row: 0, col: 0 },
    { value: 5,       row: 0, col: 1 },
    { value: 25,      row: 0, col: 2 },
    { value: 100,     row: 0, col: 3 },
    { value: 500,     row: 1, col: 0 },
    { value: 1000,    row: 1, col: 1 },
    { value: 5000,    row: 1, col: 2 },
    { value: 10000,   row: 1, col: 3 },
    { value: 50000,   row: 2, col: 0 },
    { value: 100000,  row: 2, col: 1 },
    { value: 500000,  row: 2, col: 2 },
    { value: 1000000, row: 2, col: 3 },
  ];

  function breakdown(amt: number) {
    const result: { value: number; row: number; col: number; count: number }[] = [];
    let remaining = Math.round(amt * 100) / 100;
    for (let i = DENOMS.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = DENOMS[i];
      if (remaining >= d.value) {
        const count = Math.floor(remaining / d.value);
        result.push({ ...d, count });
        remaining -= count * d.value;
      }
    }
    if (result.length === 0 && amt > 0) result.push({ ...DENOMS[0], count: 1 });
    return result;
  }

  $: stacks = breakdown(amount);

  let mounted = false;
  onMount(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => (mounted = true), 15);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  });

  $: popClass = animate && !mounted ? 'chip-pop-in' : '';
  $: pulseClass = pulse ? 'chip-pulse' : '';
  $: collectClass = collecting ? 'chip-collect' : '';
</script>

{#if amount > 0}
  <div
    class="chip-root {popClass} {pulseClass} {collectClass}"
    style="gap: {size * 0.1}px;"
  >
    {#each stacks as s}
      <div
        class="relative"
        style="
          width: {size}px;
          height: {size + (Math.min(s.count, maxStack) - 1) * (size * 0.16)}px;
        "
      >
        {#each Array(Math.min(s.count, maxStack)) as _, i}
          <div
            class="absolute"
            style="
              width: {size}px;
              height: {size}px;
              bottom: {i * (size * 0.16)}px;
              left: 0;
              background-image: url('/chips-set-hq.png');
              background-size: 400% 300%;
              background-position: {(s.col * 100) / 3}% {(s.row * 100) / 2}%;
              background-repeat: no-repeat;
              filter: drop-shadow(0 {size * 0.06}px {size * 0.1}px rgba(0,0,0,0.7));
              animation-delay: {i * 0.03}s;
            "
          ></div>
        {/each}

        {#if s.count > maxStack}
          <div
            class="absolute -top-2 -right-2 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-extrabold z-10"
            style="
              background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f4e5a8, #d4af37 45%, #a87a15);
              color: #0a0800;
              box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,235,170,0.5);
              line-height: 1;
            "
          >
            ├ù{s.count}
          </div>
        {/if}
      </div>
    {/each}
  </div>
{/if}

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/components/PokerTable.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import PlayingCard from './PlayingCard.svelte';
  import PokerChip from './PokerChip.svelte';
  import PlayerSeat from './poker/PlayerSeat.svelte';

  export let gameState: any = null;
  export let myUserId: number | null = null;
  export let myAvatarId: string = 'king';
  export let theme: 'cash' | 'tournament' = 'cash';
  export let tournamentTitle: string = '';
  export let isEliminated: boolean = false;
  export let handResult: any = null;
  export let isFinalTable: boolean = false;
  export let onPlayerClick: (userId: number) => void = () => {};

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    const num = Number(n || 0);
    if (num === Math.floor(num)) return String(Math.floor(num));
    return num.toFixed(2);
  }

  function suitChar(s: string): 'ظآب' | 'ظآح' | 'ظآخ' | 'ظآث' {
    if (s === 's') return 'ظآب';
    if (s === 'h') return 'ظآح';
    if (s === 'd') return 'ظآخ';
    return 'ظآث';
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ADAPTIVE SIZES
  // ============================================================
  type Sizes = {
    avatar: number;
    nameW: number;
    nameFont: number;
    stackFont: number;
    betChip: number;
    betFont: number;
    cardSize: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md';
    potTop: number;
    potFont: number;
    timerExtra: number;
  };

  function getSizes(total: number): Sizes {
    if (total <= 2)
      return { avatar: 62, nameW: 88, nameFont: 11, stackFont: 11, betChip: 14, betFont: 10, cardSize: 'md', potTop: 28, potFont: 14, timerExtra: 14 };
    if (total === 3)
      return { avatar: 58, nameW: 84, nameFont: 11, stackFont: 11, betChip: 14, betFont: 10, cardSize: 'md', potTop: 28, potFont: 14, timerExtra: 12 };
    if (total === 4)
      return { avatar: 52, nameW: 78, nameFont: 10, stackFont: 10, betChip: 12, betFont: 9, cardSize: 'md', potTop: 28, potFont: 13, timerExtra: 12 };
    if (total === 5)
      return { avatar: 48, nameW: 72, nameFont: 10, stackFont: 10, betChip: 12, betFont: 9, cardSize: 'sm', potTop: 28, potFont: 13, timerExtra: 10 };
    if (total === 6)
      return { avatar: 44, nameW: 68, nameFont: 10, stackFont: 9, betChip: 12, betFont: 9, cardSize: 'sm', potTop: 28, potFont: 12, timerExtra: 10 };
    if (total === 7)
      return { avatar: 40, nameW: 62, nameFont: 9, stackFont: 9, betChip: 10, betFont: 8, cardSize: 'sm', potTop: 28, potFont: 12, timerExtra: 8 };
    return { avatar: 38, nameW: 58, nameFont: 9, stackFont: 9, betChip: 10, betFont: 8, cardSize: 'sm', potTop: 28, potFont: 12, timerExtra: 8 };
  }

  // ============================================================
  // SEAT POSITION ظ¤ HERO at bottom, others counter-clockwise
  // ============================================================
  function seatPos(rotatedIdx: number, total: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    const angleDeg = 90 + (rotatedIdx * 360) / total;
    const rad = (angleDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
    const rx = 42;
    const ry = 37;
    return {
      x: 50 + Math.cos(rad) * rx,
      y: 50 + Math.sin(rad) * ry,
    };
  }

  // Bet chip offset ظ¤ outside the player seat, toward center
    function betPos(pos: { x: number; y: number }, S: Sizes): { x: string; y: string } {
    const dx = 50 - pos.x;
    const dy = 50 - pos.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
    const ux = dx / dist;
    const uy = dy / dist;

    // Side players push further toward center
    const isHorizontal = Math.abs(ux) > Math.abs(uy);
    const offPx = isHorizontal
      ? S.avatar / 2 + 60
      : S.avatar / 2 + 32;

    return {
      x: `calc(${pos.x}% + ${ux * offPx}px)`,
      y: `calc(${pos.y}% + ${uy * offPx}px)`,
    };
  }

  // ============================================================
  // REACTIVE
  // ============================================================
  $: allSeats = gameState?.seats ?? [];
  $: totalSeats = allSeats.length;
  $: S = getSizes(totalSeats);
  $: pSize = totalSeats <= 3 ? 'xl' : totalSeats <= 5 ? 'lg' : totalSeats <= 7 ? 'md' : 'sm';

  $: heroIdx = allSeats.findIndex((s: any) => Number(s.userId) === Number(myUserId));
  $: mySeat = heroIdx >= 0 ? allSeats[heroIdx] : (allSeats[0] ?? null);
  $: heroSeatNumber = mySeat?.seat ?? 0;
  $: opponents = allSeats.filter((_: any, i: number) => i !== (heroIdx >= 0 ? heroIdx : 0));

  $: winners = (gameState?.winners && gameState.winners.length > 0)
    ? gameState.winners
    : (handResult?.winners ?? []);

  $: sidePots = gameState?.sidePots ?? [];

  $: isMyTurn = !!(
    gameState &&
    mySeat &&
    gameState.currentSeat === mySeat.seat &&
    !mySeat.folded &&
    !mySeat.allIn &&
    winners.length === 0
  );

  $: totalPot = gameState?.pot ?? 0;

  $: community = (gameState?.community && gameState.community.length > 0)
    ? gameState.community
    : (handResult?.communityCards ?? []);

  $: heroShowdownPlayer = handResult?.showdownPlayers?.find(
    (p: any) => p.seat === mySeat?.seat
  );
  $: heroHole = (mySeat?.hole && mySeat.hole.length > 0)
    ? mySeat.hole
    : (heroShowdownPlayer?.hole ?? []);

  $: serverTime = gameState?.serverTime ?? Date.now();
  $: turnStartedAt = gameState?.turnStartedAt ?? 0;
  $: turnBaseLimit = gameState?.turnBaseLimit ?? 30;

  function oppPos(seatNumber: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    const rotated = ((seatNumber - heroSeatNumber + totalSeats) % totalSeats + totalSeats) % totalSeats;
    return seatPos(rotated, totalSeats);
  }

  $: showdownData = (() => {
    if (!winners || winners.length === 0) return null;
    if (!handResult?.showdownPlayers) return null;
    const map: Record<number, { isWinner: boolean; handName: string; payout: number }> = {};
    for (const p of handResult.showdownPlayers) {
      map[p.seat] = { isWinner: !!p.isWinner, handName: p.handName || '', payout: p.payout || 0 };
    }
    return map;
  })();

  function isWinnerSeat(seat: number): boolean { return winners.includes(seat); }
  function inShowdown(seat: number): boolean { return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat]); }
  function showdownWin(seat: number): boolean { return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat]?.isWinner); }
  function showdownLose(seat: number): boolean { return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat] && !showdownData[seat].isWinner); }
  function payoutForSeat(seat: number): number { return showdownData?.[seat]?.payout ?? 0; }

  $: winnerPlayer = handResult?.showdownPlayers?.find((p: any) => p.isWinner);
  $: winnerIsMe = winnerPlayer?.userId === myUserId;
  $: winnerDisplayName = winnerIsMe ? 'You' : (() => {
    const s = allSeats.find((x: any) => x.seat === winnerPlayer?.seat);
    return s?.displayName || 'Winner';
  })();

  $: winningCardKeys = new Set(
    (winnerPlayer?.bestCards ?? []).map((c: any) => `${c.r}${c.s}`)
  );
  function isWinningCard(c: any): boolean {
    return winningCardKeys.has(`${c.r}${c.s}`);
  }

  // ===== Chip fly =====
  let chipFlies: { id: number; fromX: number; fromY: number; toX: number; toY: number; delay: number }[] = [];
  let chipFlyIdCounter = 0;

  $: if (winners.length > 0 && totalPot > 0) {
    const flies: typeof chipFlies = [];
    for (const winnerSeat of winners) {
      const winnerSeatInfo = allSeats.find((s: any) => s.seat === winnerSeat);
      if (!winnerSeatInfo) continue;

      let toX = 50, toY = 50;
      if (winnerSeat === mySeat?.seat) {
        toX = 50; toY = 88;
      } else {
        const pos = oppPos(winnerSeat);
        toX = pos.x; toY = pos.y;
      }

      const payout = showdownData?.[winnerSeat]?.payout ?? 0;
      if (payout > 0) {
        flies.push({
          id: ++chipFlyIdCounter,
          fromX: 50, fromY: S.potTop,
          toX, toY,
          delay: 0.3,
        });
      }
    }
    chipFlies = flies;
  } else {
    chipFlies = [];
  }

  function shortName(name: string): string {
    if (!name) return '?';
    return name;
  }

  $: isFinal = isFinalTable;
</script>

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/components/TimerRing.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';

  export let size: number = 80;
  export let strokeWidth: number = 4;
  export let startedAt: number = 0;
  export let limitSec: number = 30;
  export let serverTime: number = Date.now();
  export let active: boolean = true;
  export let color: string = '#3b82f6';
  export let paused: boolean = false;
  export let dangerThreshold: number = 5;  // seconds
  export let warningThreshold: number = 10;

  let now = Date.now();
  let timer: any = null;

  onMount(() => {
    timer = setInterval(() => (now = Date.now()), 100);
    return () => {
      if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
    };
  });

  $: elapsed = Math.max(0, (now - startedAt) / 1000);
  $: remaining = Math.max(0, limitSec - elapsed);
  $: pct = limitSec > 0 ? remaining / limitSec : 0;

  // Color tiers: blue ظْ yellow ظْ red
    // Color tiers: green ظْ amber ظْ red (standard 80/15/5 distribution)
  $: timerColor =
    remaining <= dangerThreshold ? '#ef4444' :     // 0-5s: red (5%)
    remaining <= warningThreshold ? '#f59e0b' :    // 5-10s: amber (15%)
    '#10b981';                                      // 10-30s: green (80%)

  $: radius = (size - strokeWidth) / 2;
  $: circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  $: dashOffset = circumference * (1 - pct);

  $: displaySec = Math.ceil(remaining);
  $: isPulsing = remaining <= dangerThreshold && active && remaining > 0;
</script>

{#if active && remaining > 0}
  <div
    class="timer-ring"
    class:pulsing={isPulsing}
    style="width: {size}px; height: {size}px;"
  >
    <svg
      width={size}
      height={size}
      viewBox="0 0 {size} {size}"
      style="transform: rotate(-90deg);"
    >
      <!-- Background track -->
      <circle
        cx={size / 2}
        cy={size / 2}
        r={radius}
        fill="none"
        stroke="rgba(0,0,0,0.35)"
        stroke-width={strokeWidth}
      />

      <!-- Progress arc -->
      <circle
        cx={size / 2}
        cy={size / 2}
        r={radius}
        fill="none"
        stroke={timerColor}
        stroke-width={strokeWidth}
        stroke-linecap="round"
        stroke-dasharray={circumference}
        stroke-dashoffset={dashOffset}
        style="
          transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.15s linear, stroke 0.3s ease;
          filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px {timerColor}80);
        "
      />
    </svg>

    <!-- Countdown number -->
    <div
      class="timer-text"
      style="
        color: {timerColor};
        font-size: {size * 0.32}px;
        text-shadow: 0 0 8px {timerColor}80, 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
      "
    >
      {displaySec}
    </div>
  </div>
{/if}

<style>
  .timer-ring {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .timer-text {
    position: absolute;
    font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .timer-ring.pulsing {
    animation: timer-pulse 0.8s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes timer-pulse {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: scale(1);
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(239,68,68,0.4));
    }
    50% {
      transform: scale(1.06);

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }
  function suitChar(s: string): 'ظآب' | 'ظآح' | 'ظآخ' | 'ظآث' {
    if (s === 's') return 'ظآب';
    if (s === 'h') return 'ظآح';
    if (s === 'd') return 'ظآخ';
    return 'ظآث';
  }

  $: showFace = isShowdown || isHero;
  $: hasCards = holeCards.length > 0;
  $: faceDown = hasCards && !showFace;
  $: displayCards = hasCards ? holeCards : [];
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import PlayerSeat from './PlayerSeat.svelte';
  import PlayingCard from '../PlayingCard.svelte';
  import PokerChip from '../PokerChip.svelte';

  export let gameState: any = null;
  export let myUserId: number | null = null;
  export let myAvatarId: string = 'king';
  export let isEliminated: boolean = false;
  export let handResult: any = null;
  export let isFinalTable: boolean = false;
  export let onPlayerClick: (userId: number) => void = () => {};

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }
  function suitChar(s: string): 'ظآب' | 'ظآح' | 'ظآخ' | 'ظآث' {
    if (s === 's') return 'ظآب';
    if (s === 'h') return 'ظآح';
    if (s === 'd') return 'ظآخ';
    return 'ظآث';
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ANGLES ظ¤ hero at 90┬░ (bottom center), others counter-clockwise
  // ============================================================
  const ANGLES: Record<number, number[]> = {
    2: [90, 270],
    3: [90, 210, 330],
    4: [90, 180, 270, 0],
    5: [90, 162, 234, 306, 18],
    6: [90, 150, 210, 270, 330, 30],
    7: [90, 141, 193, 244, 296, 347, 38],
    8: [90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315, 0, 45],
    9: [90, 130, 170, 210, 250, 290, 330, 10, 50],
  };

  function seatPos(rotatedIdx: number, total: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    const angles = ANGLES[total] || ANGLES[6];
    const deg = angles[rotatedIdx] ?? 90;
    const rad = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
    // Ellipse radii ظ¤ leave room for panels & cards
    const rx = 40;
    const ry = 32;
    return { x: 50 + Math.cos(rad) * rx, y: 50 + Math.sin(rad) * ry };
  }

  // Offset a given position toward the table center by N pixels
  function offsetTowardCenter(pos: { x: number; y: number }, px: number): { x: string; y: string } {
    const dx = 50 - pos.x;
    const dy = 50 - pos.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
    return {
      x: `calc(${pos.x}% + ${(dx / dist) * px}px)`,
      y: `calc(${pos.y}% + ${(dy / dist) * px}px)`,
    };
  }

  // Size based on total players
  function playerSize(total: number): 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' {
    if (total <= 3) return 'xl';
    if (total <= 5) return 'lg';
    if (total <= 7) return 'md';
    return 'sm';
  }

  // ============================================================
  // REACTIVE
  // ============================================================
  $: allSeats = gameState?.seats ?? [];
  $: totalSeats = allSeats.length;
  $: pSize = playerSize(totalSeats);

  $: heroIdx = allSeats.findIndex((s: any) => Number(s.userId) === Number(myUserId));
  $: mySeat = heroIdx >= 0 ? allSeats[heroIdx] : (allSeats[0] ?? null);
  $: heroSeatNumber = mySeat?.seat ?? 0;
  $: opponents = allSeats.filter((_: any, i: number) => i !== (heroIdx >= 0 ? heroIdx : 0));

  $: winners = (gameState?.winners && gameState.winners.length > 0)
    ? gameState.winners
    : (handResult?.winners ?? []);

  $: sidePots = gameState?.sidePots ?? [];

  $: isMyTurn = !!(
    gameState &&
    mySeat &&
    gameState.currentSeat === mySeat.seat &&
    !mySeat.folded &&
    !mySeat.allIn &&
    winners.length === 0
  );

  $: totalPot = gameState?.pot ?? 0;

  $: community = (gameState?.community && gameState.community.length > 0)
    ? gameState.community
    : (handResult?.communityCards ?? []);

  $: heroShowdownPlayer = handResult?.showdownPlayers?.find(
    (p: any) => p.seat === mySeat?.seat
  );
  $: heroHole = (mySeat?.hole && mySeat.hole.length > 0)
    ? mySeat.hole
    : (heroShowdownPlayer?.hole ?? []);

  $: serverTime = gameState?.serverTime ?? Date.now();
  $: turnStartedAt = gameState?.turnStartedAt ?? 0;
  $: turnBaseLimit = gameState?.turnBaseLimit ?? 30;

  function oppPos(seatNumber: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    const rotated = ((seatNumber - heroSeatNumber + totalSeats) % totalSeats + totalSeats) % totalSeats;
    return seatPos(rotated, totalSeats);
  }

  $: showdownData = (() => {
    if (!winners || winners.length === 0) return null;
    if (!handResult?.showdownPlayers) return null;
    const map: Record<number, { isWinner: boolean; handName: string; payout: number }> = {};
    for (const p of handResult.showdownPlayers) {
      map[p.seat] = { isWinner: !!p.isWinner, handName: p.handName || '', payout: p.payout || 0 };
    }
    return map;
  })();

  function isWinnerSeat(seat: number): boolean { return winners.includes(seat); }
  function inShowdown(seat: number): boolean { return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat]); }
  function showdownWin(seat: number): boolean { return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat]?.isWinner); }
  function showdownLose(seat: number): boolean { return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat] && !showdownData[seat].isWinner); }
  function payoutForSeat(seat: number): number { return showdownData?.[seat]?.payout ?? 0; }

  function oppHole(seat: number): any[] {
    if (!handResult?.showdownPlayers) return [];
    const p = handResult.showdownPlayers.find((x: any) => x.seat === seat);
    return p?.hole ?? [];
  }

  // ===== Winner announcement =====
  $: winnerPlayer = handResult?.showdownPlayers?.find((p: any) => p.isWinner);
  $: winnerIsMe = winnerPlayer?.userId === myUserId;
  $: winnerDisplayName = winnerIsMe ? 'You' : (() => {
    const s = allSeats.find((x: any) => x.seat === winnerPlayer?.seat);
    return s?.displayName || 'Winner';
  })();

  // ===== Winning card highlight =====
  $: winningCardKeys = new Set(
    (winnerPlayer?.bestCards ?? []).map((c: any) => `${c.r}${c.s}`)
  );
  function isWinningCard(c: any): boolean {
    return winningCardKeys.has(`${c.r}${c.s}`);
  }
</script>

<div

        <div
          class="rounded-full pl-1.5 pr-3 py-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 pot-glow"

          "
        >
          <PokerChip amount={totalPot} size={14} />
          <span class="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-widest font-extrabold text-white/60">POT</span>
          <span class="text-[14px] font-extrabold text-gold-gradient tabular-nums">${fmt(totalPot)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    {/if}

    <!-- ========== CENTER LOGO ========== -->
    <div
      class="absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-[5] pointer-events-none flex flex-col items-center"
      style="top: 33%;"
    >
      <img
        src="/logo-flop-club.png"
        alt=""
        class="object-contain select-none"
        style="width: 36px; height: 36px; opacity: 0.32;"
        draggable="false"
      />
      <p

        style="font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 7px; letter-spacing: 0.35em; color: rgba(212,175,55,0.45); padding-left: 0.35em;"
      >
        FLOP CLUB
      </p>
    </div>

    <!-- ========== COMMUNITY CARDS ========== -->
    {#if gameState}
      <div class="absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex gap-1.5 z-[10]" style="top: 47%;">
        {#each Array(5) as _, i}
          {#if community[i]}
            {@const isWinCard = isWinningCard(community[i])}

              <PlayingCard
                rank={community[i].r}
                suit={suitChar(community[i].s)}
                size="md"
                dealFrom="top"
                dealDelay={0}
              />
              {#if isWinCard && winners.length > 0}
                <div class="absolute -inset-0.5 rounded-md winning-card-glow pointer-events-none z-[15]"></div>
              {/if}
            </div>
          {:else}
            <div
              class="rounded-md"
              style="
                width: 50px; height: 70px;
                background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
                border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.12);
                box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
              "
            ></div>
          {/if}
        {/each}
      </div>
    {/if}

    <!-- ========== OPPONENTS ========== -->
    {#each opponents as s}
      {@const pos = oppPos(s.seat)}
      {@const towardCenter = pos.x < 50 ? 'left' : 'right'}
      {@const isTurn = gameState?.currentSeat === s.seat && !s.folded && !s.allIn && winners.length === 0}
      {@const isWin = isWinnerSeat(s.seat)}
      {@const isShowdown = inShowdown(s.seat)}
      {@const isShowdownWin = showdownWin(s.seat)}
      {@const isShowdownLose = showdownLose(s.seat)}
      <!-- Use panelSide based on position: if player is on the RIGHT half, panel to the LEFT (so panel is toward center) -->
      {@const panelSide = pos.x > 50 ? 'left' : 'right'}

      <div
        class="absolute -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-[20]"
        style="left: {pos.x}%; top: {pos.y}%;"

          {isShowdown}

          holeCards={oppHole(s.seat)}

      {@const isShowdownLose = showdownLose(mySeat.seat)}

            isTurn={isMyTurn}

            {isShowdown}
            {isShowdownWin}
            {isShowdownLose}
            handName={showdownData?.[mySeat.seat]?.handName ?? ''}
            payout={payoutForSeat(mySeat.seat)}
            holeCards={[]}
            {turnStartedAt}
            {turnBaseLimit}
            {serverTime}
            size={pSize}
            cardsAbove={false}
            panelSide="right"
            onClick={() => onPlayerClick(mySeat.userId)}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    {/if}
  </div>
</div>

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/i18n/index.ts ==========
import { derived, writable } from 'svelte/store';
import en from './en';
import fa from './fa';
import ar from './ar';
import tr from './tr';
import ru from './ru';
import zh from './zh';

export type Lang = 'en' | 'fa' | 'ar' | 'tr' | 'ru' | 'zh';

export const LANGUAGES: { code: Lang; label: string; flag: string; rtl?: boolean }[] = [
  { code: 'en', label: 'English', flag: '≡اçش≡اçد' },
  { code: 'fa', label: '┘╪د╪▒╪│█î', flag: '≡اç«≡اç╖', rtl: true },
  { code: 'ar', label: '╪د┘╪╣╪▒╪ذ┘è╪ر', flag: '≡اç╕≡اçخ', rtl: true },
  { code: 'tr', label: 'T├╝rk├دe', flag: '≡اç╣≡اç╖' },
  { code: 'ru', label: '╨ب╤â╤╤╨║╨╕╨╣', flag: '≡اç╖≡اç║' },
  { code: 'zh', label: 'غ╕صµûç', flag: '≡اçذ≡اç│' },
];

const dict: Record<Lang, any> = { en, fa, ar, tr, ru, zh };

const stored =
  typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? (localStorage.getItem('lang') as Lang | null) : null;

export const lang = writable<Lang>(stored || 'en');

lang.subscribe((l) => {
  if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') localStorage.setItem('lang', l);
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    document.documentElement.lang = l;
    document.documentElement.dir = l === 'fa' || l === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  }
});

export const t = derived(lang, ($lang) => {
  const d = dict[$lang] || dict.en;
  return (key: string): string => {
    const parts = key.split('.');
    let cur: any = d;
    for (const p of parts) {
      if (cur == null) return key;
      cur = cur[p];
    }
    return cur ?? key;
  };
});

export function setLang(l: Lang) {
  lang.set(l);
}

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/lib/api.ts ==========
export const API_URL = '';

export interface ApiResponse<T = any> {
  ok: boolean;
  data?: T;
  error?: string;
  status?: number;
}

class ApiClient {
  private baseUrl: string;

  constructor(baseUrl: string) {
    this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
  }

  private getToken(): string | null {
    return localStorage.getItem('token');
  }

  async request<T = any>(path: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
    const url = `${this.baseUrl}${path}`;
    const token = this.getToken();

    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      ...((options.headers as Record<string, string>) || {}),
    };

    if (token) {
      headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { ...options, headers });

      let data: any = null;
      const contentType = res.headers.get('content-type');
      if (contentType?.includes('application/json')) {
        data = await res.json();
      }

      if (!res.ok) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          error: data?.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`,
          status: res.status,
        };
      }

      return { ok: true, data, status: res.status };
    } catch (e: any) {
      return { ok: false, error: e.message || 'network_error' };
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Auth
  // ============================================================
  async authTelegram(initData: string): Promise<ApiResponse<{ token: string; user: any }>> {
    return this.request('/api/auth/telegram', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ initData }),
    });
  }

  async me(): Promise<ApiResponse<{ user: any; wallet: any; free_chips: any }>> {
    return this.request('/api/me');
  }

  async updateAvatar(avatarId: string): Promise<ApiResponse<{ ok: boolean; avatar_id: string }>> {
    return this.request('/api/me/avatar', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ avatar_id: avatarId }),
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Tables
  // ============================================================
  async tables(): Promise<ApiResponse<{ tables: any[] }>> {
    return this.request('/api/tables');
  }

  async getTables(): Promise<ApiResponse<{ tables: any[] }>> {
    return this.request('/api/tables');
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Leaderboard / Events
  // ============================================================
  async leaderboard(period: string = 'all'): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request(`/api/leaderboard?period=${period}`);
  }

  async getLeaderboard(period: string = 'all'): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request(`/api/leaderboard?period=${period}`);
  }

  async getSeasonLeaderboard(): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request('/api/leaderboard/season');
  }

  async getMySeasonRank(): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request('/api/leaderboard/season/me');
  }

  async getMyTournaments(filter: string = 'all', limit: number = 50): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request(`/api/my/tournaments?filter=${filter}&limit=${limit}`);
  }

  async events(): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request('/api/events');
  }

  async getEvents(): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request('/api/events');
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Hands
  // ============================================================
  async getRecentHands(limit = 20, offset = 0): Promise<ApiResponse<{ hands: any[] }>> {
    return this.request(`/api/hands/recent?limit=${limit}&offset=${offset}`);
  }

  async getHandDetail(handId: number): Promise<ApiResponse<{ hand: any; events: any[] }>> {
    return this.request(`/api/hands/${handId}`);
  }

  async getHandReplay(
    handId: number,
  ): Promise<ApiResponse<{ hand: any; initialSnapshot: any; events: any[] }>> {
    return this.request(`/api/hands/${handId}/replay`);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Wallet
  // ============================================================
  async walletBalance(): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request('/api/wallet/balance');
  }

  async walletDepositInfo(): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request('/api/wallet/deposit-info');
  }

  async walletHistory(): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request('/api/wallet/history');
  }

  async walletWithdraw(amountTon: number, toAddress: string): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request('/api/wallet/withdraw', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ amountTon, toAddress }),
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Tournaments
  // ============================================================
  async listTournaments(filter?: {
    status?: string;
    variant?: string;
    mode?: string;
  }): Promise<ApiResponse<{ tournaments: any[] }>> {
    const qs = new URLSearchParams();
    if (filter?.status) qs.set('status', filter.status);
    if (filter?.variant) qs.set('variant', filter.variant);
    if (filter?.mode) qs.set('mode', filter.mode);
    const q = qs.toString();
    return this.request(`/api/tournaments${q ? '?' + q : ''}`);
  }

  async getTournament(id: number): Promise<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.request(`/api/tournaments/${id}`);
  }

  async createTournament(body: any): Promise<ApiResponse<{ ok: boolean; tournamentId: number }>> {
    return this.request('/api/tournaments', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
  }

  async registerTournament(id: number): Promise<ApiResponse<{ ok: boolean }>> {
    return this.request(`/api/tournaments/${id}/register`, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({}),
    });
  }

  async unregisterTournament(id: number): Promise<ApiResponse<{ ok: boolean }>> {
    return this.request(`/api/tournaments/${id}/unregister`, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({}),
    });
  }

  async startTournament(id: number): Promise<ApiResponse<{ ok: boolean }>> {
    return this.request(`/api/tournaments/${id}/start`, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({}),
    });
  }

  async listBlindStructures(): Promise<ApiResponse<{ structures: any[] }>> {
    return this.request('/api/blind-structures');
  }
}

export const api = new ApiClient(API_URL);

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/lib/haptics.ts ==========
// ============================================================
// Haptics Manager (Telegram WebApp + navigator.vibrate fallback)
// ============================================================

type HapticStyle = 'light' | 'medium' | 'heavy' | 'rigid' | 'soft';
type HapticNotif = 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

let enabled = true;

if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
  try {
    const settings = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('settings') || '{}');
    enabled = settings.haptics !== false;
  } catch {}
}

export function setHapticsEnabled(v: boolean) {
  enabled = v;
}

export function isHapticsEnabled() {
  return enabled;
}

function tg() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  const w = window as any;
  return w.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback ?? null;
}

export const haptic = {
  light() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.impactOccurred('light'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.(8); } catch {}
  },

  medium() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.impactOccurred('medium'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.(18); } catch {}
  },

  heavy() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.impactOccurred('heavy'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.(35); } catch {}
  },

  success() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.notificationOccurred('success'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.([15, 40, 15]); } catch {}
  },

  warning() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.notificationOccurred('warning'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.([25, 50, 25]); } catch {}
  },

  error() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.notificationOccurred('error'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.([60, 40, 60, 40, 60]); } catch {}
  },
};

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/lib/notifications.ts ==========
import { writable } from 'svelte/store';

export interface Notif {
  id: string;
  icon: string;
  title: string;
  message?: string;
  color: string;
  ts: number;
}

export const notifications = writable<Notif[]>([]);

export function pushNotif(n: Omit<Notif, 'id' | 'ts'>): void {
  const id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  const item: Notif = { ...n, id, ts: Date.now() };
  notifications.update((arr) => {
    // Cap at 4 toasts
    const next = [...arr, item];
    return next.length > 4 ? next.slice(next.length - 4) : next;
  });
  setTimeout(() => {
    notifications.update((arr) => arr.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
  }, 5000);
}

export function dismissNotif(id: string): void {
  notifications.update((arr) => arr.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
}

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/lib/realtime.ts ==========
import { io, type Socket } from 'socket.io-client';
import { writable } from 'svelte/store';

const API_URL = '';

let socket: Socket | null = null;

export const realtimeConnected = writable(false);

export function initRealtime(token: string): Socket {
  if (socket) {
    // If already connected, ensure auth is up to date
    (socket.auth as any) = { token };
    if (!socket.connected) socket.connect();
    return socket;
  }

  socket = io(API_URL, {
    auth: { token },
    transports: ['websocket'],
    reconnection: true,
    reconnectionDelay: 1000,
    reconnectionDelayMax: 5000,
  });

  socket.on('connect', () => {
    realtimeConnected.set(true);
    console.log('[realtime] connected', socket?.id);
  });

  socket.on('disconnect', (reason) => {
    realtimeConnected.set(false);
    console.log('[realtime] disconnected:', reason);
  });

  socket.on('connect_error', (err) => {
    console.warn('[realtime] connect_error:', err.message);
  });

  return socket;
}

export function getRealtime(): Socket | null {
  return socket;
}

export function closeRealtime(): void {
  if (socket) {
    socket.disconnect();
    socket = null;
    realtimeConnected.set(false);
  }
}

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/lib/socket.ts ==========
import { io, Socket } from 'socket.io-client';

const API_URL = '';

export interface TableState {
  seats: any[];
  community: any[];
  phase: string;
  currentSeat: number;
  pot: number;
  minRaise: number;
  smallBlind: number;
  bigBlind: number;
  dealerSeat: number;
  winners: number[] | null;
  handNo: number;
  sequence: number;
  serverSeedHash: string;
  serverSeed?: string;
  serverTime: number;
  turnStartedAt: number;
  autoActionAt: number;
  turnBaseLimit: number;
  timeBankLimit: number;
  turnBankActive?: boolean;
  variant?: string;
  mode?: 'free' | 'real';
  totalRake?: number;
  totalRebuy?: number;
}

export interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  userId: number;
  displayName: string;
  avatarId: string;
  text: string;
  isEmoji: boolean;
  timestamp: number;
}

export type SocketEvent =
  | { type: 'state'; state: TableState }
  | { type: 'hand_result'; result: any; state: any }
  | { type: 'connected' }
  | { type: 'disconnected'; reason: string }
  | { type: 'reconnecting'; attempt: number }
  | { type: 'reconnected'; syncType: string }
  | { type: 'player_joined'; userId: number; displayName: string; total: number }
  | { type: 'player_left'; userId: number; total: number }
  | { type: 'chat'; message: ChatMessage }
  | { type: 'error'; message: string; code?: string };

type Listener = (e: SocketEvent) => void;

export class TableSocketIO {
  private socket: Socket | null = null;
  private listeners: Set<Listener> = new Set();
  private token: string;
  private tableId: number;
  private closedByUser = false;

  private lastHandNo: number = 0;
  private lastSequence: number = 0;
  private reconnectAttempt = 0;

  constructor(tableId: number, token: string) {
    this.tableId = tableId;
    this.token = token;
  }

  connect(): void {
    this.closedByUser = false;

    this.socket = io(API_URL, {
      auth: {
        token: this.token,
        device: this.getDeviceHash(),
      },
      transports: ['websocket', 'polling'],
      reconnection: true,
      reconnectionDelay: 1000,
      reconnectionDelayMax: 5000,
      reconnectionAttempts: Infinity,
      timeout: 20000,
    });

    this.socket.on('connect', () => {
      const isReconnect = this.reconnectAttempt > 0;
      this.emit({ type: 'connected' });
      this.reconnectAttempt = 0;

      this.socket?.emit(
        'table:join',
        {
          tableId: this.tableId,
          lastHandNo: this.lastHandNo,
          lastSequence: this.lastSequence,
        },
        (res: any) => {
          if (!res?.ok) {
            this.emit({ type: 'error', message: res?.error ?? 'join_failed', code: res?.code });
            return;
          }
          if (isReconnect) {
            this.emit({ type: 'reconnected', syncType: res.syncType || 'full' });
          }
        },
      );
    });

    this.socket.on('table:state', (state: TableState) => {
      if (typeof state.handNo === 'number') this.lastHandNo = state.handNo;
      if (typeof state.sequence === 'number') this.lastSequence = state.sequence;
      this.emit({ type: 'state', state });
    });

    this.socket.on('table:hand_result', (data: any) => {
      if (data?.state?.handNo) this.lastHandNo = data.state.handNo;
      this.emit({
        type: 'hand_result',
        result: data?.result,
        state: data?.state,
      });
    });

    this.socket.on('table:player_joined', (data: any) => {
      this.emit({
        type: 'player_joined',
        userId: data.userId,
        displayName: data.displayName,
        total: data.total,
      });
    });

    this.socket.on('table:player_left', (data: any) => {
      this.emit({
        type: 'player_left',
        userId: data.userId,
        total: data.total,
      });
    });

    this.socket.on('table:chat_message', (msg: ChatMessage) => {
      this.emit({ type: 'chat', message: msg });
    });

    this.socket.on('connect_error', (err: any) => {
      this.emit({ type: 'error', message: err.message });
    });

    this.socket.io.on('reconnect_attempt', (attempt: number) => {
      this.reconnectAttempt = attempt;
      this.emit({ type: 'reconnecting', attempt });
    });

    this.socket.on('disconnect', (reason: string) => {
      if (!this.closedByUser) {
        this.emit({ type: 'disconnected', reason });
      }
    });
  }

  private getDeviceHash(): string {
    let device = localStorage.getItem('device_hash');
    if (!device) {
      device = 'dev_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
      localStorage.setItem('device_hash', device);
    }
    return device;
  }

  private emit(event: SocketEvent): void {
    for (const l of this.listeners) {
      try {
        l(event);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
      }
    }
  }

  action(action: 'FOLD' | 'CHECK' | 'CALL' | 'RAISE', amount = 0): void {
    if (!this.socket?.connected) return;

    const commandId = this.generateCommandId();

    this.socket.emit('table:action', { action, amount, commandId }, (res: any) => {
      if (!res?.ok) {
        this.emit({ type: 'error', message: res?.error ?? 'action_failed', code: res?.code });
      }
    });
  }

  private generateCommandId(): string {
    return `${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 12)}`;
  }

  useTimeBank(): void {
    if (!this.socket?.connected) return;
    this.socket.emit('table:time_bank', {}, () => {});
  }

  requestResync(): void {
    if (!this.socket?.connected) return;
    this.socket.emit(
      'table:resync',
      {
        tableId: this.tableId,
        lastHandNo: this.lastHandNo,
        lastSequence: this.lastSequence,
      },
      (res: any) => {
        if (res?.ok) {
          this.emit({ type: 'reconnected', syncType: res.syncType || 'full' });
        }
      },
    );
  }

  leaveTable(): void {
    if (!this.socket?.connected) return;
    this.socket.emit('table:leave', {}, () => {});
  }

  // ============================================================
  // CHAT
  // ============================================================
  sendChat(text: string, isEmoji = false): Promise<{ ok: boolean; code?: string }> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (!this.socket?.connected) {
        resolve({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_CONNECTED' });
        return;
      }
      this.socket.emit('table:chat', { text, isEmoji }, (res: any) => {
        resolve(res ?? { ok: false, code: 'NO_ACK' });
      });
    });
  }

  requestChatHistory(): Promise<ChatMessage[]> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (!this.socket?.connected) {
        resolve([]);
        return;
      }
      this.socket.emit('table:chat_history', {}, (res: any) => {
        resolve(res?.messages ?? []);
      });
    });
  }

  on(listener: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
  }

  close(): void {
    this.closedByUser = true;
    this.listeners.clear();
    if (this.socket) {
      this.socket.disconnect();
      this.socket = null;
    }
  }
}

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/lib/sounds.ts ==========
// ============================================================
// Sound Effects Manager
// ============================================================

type SoundName = 'chip' | 'deal' | 'card-flip' | 'win' | 'lose' | 'button' | 'check';

const SOUND_FILES: Record<SoundName, string> = {
  chip: '/sounds/chip.wav',
  deal: '/sounds/deal.wav',
  'card-flip': '/sounds/card-flip.wav',
  win: '/sounds/win.wav',
  lose: '/sounds/lose.wav',
  button: '/sounds/button.wav',
  check: '/sounds/check.wav',
};

const cache: Partial<Record<SoundName, HTMLAudioElement>> = {};

let enabled = true;
let masterVolume = 0.6;

// Load from localStorage
if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
  try {
    const settings = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('settings') || '{}');
    enabled = settings.sound !== false;
  } catch {}
}

export function setSoundEnabled(v: boolean) {
  enabled = v;
}

export function isSoundEnabled() {
  return enabled;
}

export function setMasterVolume(v: number) {
  masterVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
}

export function playSound(name: SoundName, volume?: number) {
  if (!enabled) return;
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  try {
    let audio = cache[name];
    if (!audio) {
      audio = new Audio(SOUND_FILES[name]);
      audio.preload = 'auto';
      cache[name] = audio;
    }

    // Clone for overlapping plays
    const instance = audio.cloneNode() as HTMLAudioElement;
    instance.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume ?? masterVolume));
    instance.play().catch(() => {
      // Browser autoplay blocked ظ¤ ignore
    });
  } catch {}
}

export function preloadAllSounds() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  (Object.keys(SOUND_FILES) as SoundName[]).forEach((name) => {
    try {
      const audio = new Audio(SOUND_FILES[name]);
      audio.preload = 'auto';
      cache[name] = audio;
    } catch {}
  });
}

  type Achievement = {
    id: number;
    code: string;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    icon: string;
    category: string;
    threshold: number;
    progress: number;
    unlocked: boolean;
    unlockedAt: string | null;
    claimed: boolean;
    claimedAt: string | null;
    rewardChips: number;
    rewardUsd: number;
  };

  let achievements: Achievement[] = [];
  let loading = true;
  let error = '';
  let toast = '';
  let activeFilter: 'all' | 'hand' | 'tournament' | 'wallet' | 'special' = 'all';
  let claiming: string | null = null;

  function token(): string | null {
    return localStorage.getItem('token');
  }

  async function load() {
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const t = token();
      const res = await fetch('/api/me/achievements', {
        headers: t ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${t}` } : {},
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        error = `HTTP ${res.status}`;
        return;
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      achievements = data.achievements || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  async function claim(code: string) {
    claiming = code;
    try {
      const t = token();
      const res = await fetch(`/api/me/achievements/${code}/claim`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          ...(t ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${t}` } : {}),
        },
        body: '{}',
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        toast = `ظ£à Reward claimed!`;
        setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3000);
        await load();
        await auth.refresh();
      } else {
        toast = `ظإî ${data.error || 'claim failed'}`;
        setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3000);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast = `ظإî ${e.message}`;
      setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3000);
    } finally {
      claiming = null;
    }
  }

  onMount(load);

  $: filtered = activeFilter === 'all'
    ? achievements
    : achievements.filter((a) => a.category === activeFilter);

  $: unlockedCount = achievements.filter((a) => a.unlocked).length;
  $: totalCount = achievements.length;
  $: claimableCount = achievements.filter((a) => a.unlocked && !a.claimed).length;
  $: completionPct = totalCount > 0 ? Math.round((unlockedCount / totalCount) * 100) : 0;

    { key: 'special', label: 'Special' },
  ];

  async function login() {
    if (!adminSecret) return;

    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/stats`, { headers: headers() });
      if (res.ok) {

      loading = false;

  async function loadTab(tab: Tab) {
