      const [o, l] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/overview`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/live`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      overview = o;
      liveRooms = l.rooms || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      overviewLoading = false;
    }
  }

  async function loadTournaments() {
    try {
      const [t, b, tpl] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournaments`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/blind-structures`).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournament-templates`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      tournaments = t.tournaments || [];
      blindStructures = b.structures || [];
      templates = tpl.templates || [];
      if (blindStructures.length > 0 && !form.blindStructureId) {
        form.blindStructureId = blindStructures[0].id;
      }
      if (blindStructures.length > 0 && !tform.blindStructureId) {
        tform.blindStructureId = blindStructures[0].id;
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    }
  }

  async function loadTables() {
    tablesLoading = true;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tables`, { headers: headers() });
      const data = await res.json();
      tables = data.tables || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      tablesLoading = false;
    }
  }

  async function loadPlayers() {
    playersLoading = true;
    try {
      const qs = new URLSearchParams();
      if (playersSearch) qs.set('search', playersSearch);
      if (playersFilter !== 'all') qs.set('filter', playersFilter);
      qs.set('limit', '50');
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/users?${qs}`, { headers: headers() });
      const data = await res.json();
      players = data.users || [];
      playersTotal = data.total || 0;
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      playersLoading = false;
    }
  }

  async function loadPlayerDetail(id: number) {
    playerDetailLoading = true;
    try {
      const [d, h] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/users/${id}`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/users/${id}/history?limit=20`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      playerDetail = d.user;
      playerHistory = h;
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      playerDetailLoading = false;
    }
  }

  async function loadAnticheat() {
    anticheatLoading = true;
    try {
      const resolvedParam =
        anticheatFilter === 'resolved' ? '?resolved=true' :
        anticheatFilter === 'unresolved' ? '?resolved=false' : '';
      const [s, r, e] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/anticheat/stats`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/anticheat/risky-users`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/anticheat/events${resolvedParam}`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      anticheat = s;
      riskyUsers = r.users || [];
      anticheatEvents = e.events || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      anticheatLoading = false;
    }
  }

  async function loadWallet() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/actions?limit=50`, { headers: headers() });
      const data = await res.json();
      walletActions = (data.actions || []).filter((a: any) =>
        a.action === 'adjust_wallet' || a.action === 'ban_user' || a.action === 'unban_user'
      );
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    }
  }

  async function loadBroadcasts() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/broadcasts`, { headers: headers() });
      const data = await res.json();
      broadcasts = data.broadcasts || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    }
  }

  async function loadSettings() {
    settingsLoading = true;
    try {
      const [s, a] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/settings`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/actions?limit=30`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      settings = s.settings || {};
      actionsLog = a.actions || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      settingsLoading = false;
    }
  }

  // ============ ACTIONS ظ¤ TOURNAMENTS ============
  async function createTournament() {
    if (!form.name.trim()) { error = 'Name required'; return; }
    creating = true; error = '';
    try {
      const payload = {
        ...form,
        startingStack: Number(form.startingStack) || 1500,
        buyIn: Number(form.buyIn) || 0,
        fee: Number(form.fee) || 0,
        minPlayers: Number(form.minPlayers) || 2,
        maxPlayers: Number(form.maxPlayers) || 9,
        guaranteed: Number(form.guaranteed) || 0,
        lateRegLevel: Number(form.lateRegLevel) || 0,
        maxReEntries: Number(form.maxReEntries) || 1,
        bountyAmount: Number(form.bountyAmount) || 0,
        seatsAwarded: Number(form.seatsAwarded) || 0,
        blindStructureId: Number(form.blindStructureId),
        scheduledStart: form.scheduledStart ? new Date(form.scheduledStart).toISOString() : null,
      };
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/tournaments`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        flash(`ظ£à Tournament #${data.tournamentId} created`);
        showCreate = false; form.name = ''; form.scheduledStart = '';
        await loadTournaments();
      } else error = data.error || 'create_failed';
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; }
    finally { creating = false; }
  }

  async function startTournament(id: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Start tournament #${id}?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/tournaments/${id}/start`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: '{}',
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash(`≡اأ Started #${id}`); await loadTournaments(); }
    else error = 'start_failed';
  }

  async function pauseTournament(id: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Pause #${id}?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournaments/${id}/pause`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: '{}',
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash(`ظ╕ي╕ Paused #${id}`); await loadTournaments(); }
    else error = 'pause_failed';
  }

  async function resumeTournament(id: number) {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournaments/${id}/resume`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: '{}',
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash(`ظû╢ي╕ Resumed #${id}`); await loadTournaments(); }
    else error = 'resume_failed';
  }

  async function cancelTournament(id: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Cancel #${id} + refund?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournaments/${id}/cancel`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: '{}',
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) { flash(`ظإî Cancelled (${data.refunded} refunded)`); await loadTournaments(); }
    else error = data.error || 'cancel_failed';
  }

  async function createTemplate() {
    if (!tform.name.trim()) { error = 'Name required'; return; }
    creatingTemplate = true; error = '';
    try {
      const payload = { ...tform, blindStructureId: Number(tform.blindStructureId) };
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournament-templates`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        flash(`ظ£à Template #${data.templateId} created`);
        showTemplateForm = false; tform.name = '';
        await loadTournaments();
      } else error = data.error || 'create_failed';
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; }
    finally { creatingTemplate = false; }
  }

  async function toggleTemplate(id: number, active: boolean) {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournament-templates/${id}/toggle`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify({ active }),
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash(active ? 'ظû╢ي╕ Activated' : 'ظ╕ي╕ Paused'); await loadTournaments(); }

  async function deleteTemplate(id: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Delete template #${id}?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournament-templates/${id}`, {
      method: 'DELETE', headers: headers(),

    if (res.ok) { flash('≡اùّي╕ Deleted'); await loadTournaments(); }
  }

  // ============ ACTIONS ظ¤ TABLES ============
  function resetTableForm() {
    tableForm = {
      name: '', variant: 'holdem', mode: 'free', speed: 'regular',
      small_blind: 1, big_blind: 2, ante: 0,
      min_buyin: 100, max_buyin: 1000, rake_pct: 0.03, seats: 6,
    };
  }

  async function createTable() {
    if (!tableForm.name.trim()) { error = 'Name required'; return; }
    creatingTable = true; error = '';
    try {
      const payload = {
        name: tableForm.name, variant: tableForm.variant, mode: tableForm.mode,
        speed: tableForm.speed,
        small_blind: Number(tableForm.small_blind) || 1,
        big_blind: Number(tableForm.big_blind) || 2,
        ante: Number(tableForm.ante) || 0,
        min_buyin: Number(tableForm.min_buyin) || 0,
        max_buyin: Number(tableForm.max_buyin) || 0,
        rake_pct: Number(tableForm.rake_pct) || 0,
        seats: Number(tableForm.seats) || 6,
      };
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tables`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        flash(`ظ£à Table "${payload.name}" created`);
        showTableForm = false; resetTableForm();
        await loadTables();
      } else error = data.error || 'create_failed';
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; }
    finally { creatingTable = false; }
  }

  async function deleteTable(id: number, name: string) {
    if (!confirm(`Delete table "${name}"?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tables/${id}`, {
      method: 'DELETE', headers: headers(),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) { flash(`≡اùّي╕ Deleted`); await loadTables(); }
    else error = data.error === 'table_has_players' ? 'Table has live players' : data.error;
  }

  async function toggleTable(id: number, active: boolean) {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tables/${id}/toggle`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify({ active }),
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash(active ? 'ظû╢ي╕ Activated' : 'ظ╕ي╕ Paused'); await loadTables(); }
  }

  // ============ ACTIONS ظ¤ PLAYERS ============
  async function openPlayer(p: any) {
    selectedPlayer = p;
    playerDetail = null;
    playerHistory = null;
    walletAdjustAmount = 0;
    walletAdjustReason = '';
    await loadPlayerDetail(p.id);
  }

  function closePlayer() {
    selectedPlayer = null;
    playerDetail = null;
    playerHistory = null;
  }

  async function banPlayer(id: number, ban: boolean) {
    const reason = prompt(ban ? 'Ban reason:' : 'Unban reason:') ?? 'admin action';
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/users/${id}/ban`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ ban, reason }),
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      flash(ban ? '≡اأس Banned' : 'ظ£à Unbanned');
      await loadPlayerDetail(id);
      await loadPlayers();
    } else error = 'ban_failed';
  }

  async function adjustWallet(id: number) {
    if (!walletAdjustAmount) return;
    walletAdjusting = true;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/users/${id}/wallet`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: headers(),
        body: JSON.stringify({
          amount: walletAdjustAmount,
          reason: walletAdjustReason || 'admin adjustment',
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        flash(`≡اْ░ Balance: $${data.newBalance.toFixed(2)}`);
        walletAdjustAmount = 0;
        walletAdjustReason = '';
        await loadPlayerDetail(id);
        await loadPlayers();
      } else error = data.error || 'adjust_failed';
    } finally { walletAdjusting = false; }
  }

  // ============ ACTIONS ظ¤ ANTI-CHEAT ============
  async function resolveEvent(id: number) {
    const note = prompt('Resolution note (optional):') ?? '';
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/anticheat/events/${id}/resolve`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify({ note }),
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash('ظ£à Resolved'); await loadAnticheat(); }
  }

  async function banRiskyUser(userId: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Ban user #${userId}?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/anticheat/user/${userId}/ban`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ ban: true, reason: 'anticheat' }),
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash('≡اأس Banned'); await loadAnticheat(); }
  }

  // ============ ACTIONS ظ¤ BROADCAST ============
  async function createBroadcast() {
    if (!bcastForm.title.trim() || !bcastForm.message.trim()) {
      error = 'Title and message required'; return;
    }
    broadcasting = true; error = '';
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/broadcasts`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify(bcastForm),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        flash(`≡اôت Broadcast #${data.broadcastId} sent`);
        showBroadcastForm = false;
        bcastForm = { title: '', message: '', target: 'all', severity: 'info' };
        await loadBroadcasts();
      } else error = data.error || 'broadcast_failed';
    } finally { broadcasting = false; }
  }

  async function deleteBroadcast(id: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Delete broadcast #${id}?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/broadcasts/${id}`, {
      method: 'DELETE', headers: headers(),

    if (res.ok) { flash('≡اùّي╕ Deleted'); await loadBroadcasts(); }
  }

  // ============ ACTIONS ظ¤ SETTINGS ============
  async function saveSettings() {
    settingsSaving = true;
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, any> = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(settings)) {
        payload[k] = settings[k].value;
      }
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/settings`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      if (res.ok) { flash('≡اْ╛ Settings saved'); await loadSettings(); }
      else error = 'save_failed';
    } finally { settingsSaving = false; }
  }

  async function toggleSetting(key: string) {
    settings[key] = { ...settings[key], value: !settings[key].value };
  }

  // ============ HELPERS ============
  function fmtDate(iso: string | null): string {
    if (!iso) return 'ظ¤';
    try {
      return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('en-US', {
        month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
      });
    } catch { return 'ظ¤'; }
  }

  function fmtMoney(n: any): string {
    return `$${Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)}`;
  }

  function logout() {
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    adminSecret = ''; authed = false;
  }

  function statusColor(s: string): string {
    if (s === 'running') return '#10b981';
    if (s === 'final_table') return '#d4af37';
    if (s === 'registering') return '#22d3ee';
    if (s === 'scheduled') return '#8b5cf6';
    if (s === 'finished') return '#6b7280';
    if (s === 'paused') return '#f59e0b';
    if (s === 'cancelled') return '#ef4444';
    return '#6b7280';
  }

  function variantColor(v: string): string {
    if (v === 'holdem') return '#3b82f6';
    if (v === 'omaha4') return '#ef4444';
    if (v === 'omaha5') return '#10b981';
    return '#d4af37';
  }

  function variantLabel(v: string): string {
    if (v === 'holdem') return "Hold'em";
    if (v === 'omaha4') return 'Omaha 4';
    if (v === 'omaha5') return 'Omaha 5';
    return v;
  }

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte'
  import { api } from '../lib/api'

  type EventItem = {
    id: string
    title: string
    description: string
    startsAt: string
    prize: number
    image?: string
  }

  let events: EventItem[] = []
  let loading = true
  let selected: EventItem | null = null

  onMount(async () => {
    try {
      events = await api.get('/api/events')
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[Events] load failed', e)
      events = []
    } finally {
      loading = false
    }
  })

  function openDetail(ev: EventItem) {
    selected = ev
  }

  function closeDetail() {
    selected = null
  }

  function formatDate(iso: string) {
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('fa-IR', {
      dateStyle: 'medium',
      timeStyle: 'short',
    })
  }
</script>

<div class="events-page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <h1>╪▒┘ê█î╪»╪د╪»┘ç╪د</h1>

  {:else if events.length === 0}
    <div class="state">╪▒┘ê█î╪»╪د╪»█î ┘ê╪ش┘ê╪» ┘╪»╪د╪▒╪»</div>
  {:else}
    <ul class="event-list">
      {#each events as ev (ev.id)}
        <li class="event-card" onclick={() => openDetail(ev)} role="button" tabindex="0"
            onkeydown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && openDetail(ev)}>
          {#if ev.image}
            <img class="thumb" src={ev.image} alt={ev.title} />
          {/if}
          <div class="body">
            <span class="title">{ev.title}</span>
            <span class="date">{formatDate(ev.startsAt)}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="prize">{ev.prize.toLocaleString()} TON</div>
        </li>
      {/each}
    </ul>
  {/if}
</div>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';
  import Avatar from '../components/Avatar.svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { t } from '../i18n';

  let loading = true;
  let period: any = null;
  let entries: any[] = [];
  let myEntry: any = null;
  let myRank: number | null = null;
  let displayPrizePool = 0;
  let refreshTimer: any = null;

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function handsLabel(n: number): string {
    return n === 1 ? 'hand' : 'hands';
  }

  function normalize(e: any, idx: number) {
    return {
      user_id: e.user_id ?? e.userId ?? e.id,
      rank: e.rank ?? idx + 1,
      avatar_id: e.avatar_id ?? e.avatarId ?? 'spade',
      display_name: e.display_name ?? e.name ?? 'Player',
      hands_played: e.hands_played ?? 0,
      total_won_usd: e.total_won_usd ?? 0,
      prize_usd: e.prize_usd ?? 0,
    };
  }

  async function loadAll() {
    try {
      const [cur, me] = await Promise.all([
        api.getSeasonLeaderboard(),
        api.getMySeasonRank(),
      ]);
      if (cur.ok && cur.data) {
        period = cur.data.period ?? null;
        const raw = cur.data.entries ?? cur.data.leaderboard ?? [];
        entries = raw.map((e: any, i: number) => normalize(e, i));
        displayPrizePool = cur.data.livePrizePool ?? cur.data.prizePool ?? 0;
      }
      if (me.ok && me.data) {
        myEntry = me.data.entry ? normalize(me.data.entry, 0) : null;
        myRank = me.data.liveRank ?? me.data.rank ?? null;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[Leaderboard] load failed', e);
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  async function refresh() {
    try {
      const res = await api.getSeasonLeaderboard();
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        const raw = res.data.entries ?? res.data.leaderboard ?? [];
        entries = raw.map((e: any, i: number) => normalize(e, i));
        period = res.data.period ?? null;
        displayPrizePool = res.data.livePrizePool ?? res.data.prizePool ?? 0;
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  onMount(async () => {
    await loadAll();
    refreshTimer = setInterval(refresh, 5000);
  });

  onDestroy(() => {
    if (refreshTimer) clearInterval(refreshTimer);
  });

  $: first  = entries[0] ?? null;
  $: second = entries[1] ?? null;
  $: third  = entries[2] ?? null;
  $: rest   = entries.slice(3);
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';

  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  type Filter = 'all' | 'won' | 'itm' | 'eliminated';

  let filter: Filter = 'all';
  let loading = true;
  let tournaments: any[] = [];
  let stats: any = null;

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function fmtDate(iso: string | null): string {
    if (!iso) return 'ظ¤';
    try {
      return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('en-US', {
        month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
      });
    } catch { return 'ظ¤'; }
  }

  function statusColor(t: any): string {
    if (t.isWinner) return '#f4c95d';
    if (t.payout > 0) return '#10b981';
    if (t.entryStatus === 'qualified') return '#a78bfa';
    return '#6b7280';
  }

  function statusLabel(t: any): string {
    if (t.isWinner) return '≡ا WON';
    if (t.entryStatus === 'qualified') return '≡ااي╕ QUALIFIED';
    if (t.payout > 0) return '≡اْ░ ITM';
    if (t.entryStatus === 'eliminated') return '≡اْ OUT';
    if (t.entryStatus === 'refunded') return 'ظري╕ REFUNDED';
    return t.entryStatus?.toUpperCase() || 'ظ¤';
  }

  async function load() {
    loading = true;
    try {
      const res = await api.getMyTournaments(filter, 100);
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        tournaments = res.data.tournaments || [];
        stats = res.data.stats;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  function setFilter(f: Filter) {
    filter = f;
    load();
  }

  onMount(load);

  $: roiColor = stats ? (stats.roi >= 0 ? '#6ee7b7' : '#fca5a5') : '#fff';
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';

  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  interface Notification {
    id: string;
    type: 'tournament' | 'friend' | 'reward' | 'security' | 'system';
    title: string;
    message: string;
    time: string;
    read: boolean;
  }

  let notifications: Notification[] = [
    { id: '1', type: 'reward', title: 'Welcome Bonus', message: 'You received 1,000 free chips. Good luck!', time: '2 minutes ago', read: false },
    { id: '2', type: 'system', title: 'New Tournaments Available', message: 'Daily Deepstack is now open for registration.', time: '1 hour ago', read: false },
    { id: '3', type: 'security', title: 'New Login Detected', message: 'Your account was accessed from a new device.', time: '3 hours ago', read: true },

    friend: '≡اّح',
    reward: '≡ا',

  let adminTapCount = 0;
  let adminTapTimer: any = null;

  function handleVersionTap() {
    adminTapCount++;
    if (adminTapTimer) clearTimeout(adminTapTimer);

    if (adminTapCount >= 20) {
      adminTapCount = 0;
      requestAdmin();
      return;
    }

    adminTapTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      adminTapCount = 0;
    }, 5000);
  }

  $: user = $auth.user;
  $: chips = $auth.freeChips;

  $: handsPlayed = chips?.total_hands || 0;

  $: xpInLevel = handsPlayed % 50;
  $: xpCurrent = 2460 + xpInLevel * 20;

    await auth.refresh();

    if (user) (user as any).frame_id = frame;
    // TODO: save to backend later
  }

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';
  import { cardTheme, CARD_THEMES } from '../stores/cardTheme';
  import { setSoundEnabled } from '../lib/sounds';
  import { setHapticsEnabled } from '../lib/haptics';

  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  let sound = true;
  let music = false;
  let haptics = true;
  let animations = true;
  let graphics: 'ultra' | 'high' | 'medium' | 'performance' = 'high';
  let autoMuck = true;
  let fourColor = false;
  let betSlider = true;
  let autoPostBlinds = true;

  onMount(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('settings');
      if (saved) {
        const s = JSON.parse(saved);
        sound = s.sound ?? true;
        music = s.music ?? false;
        haptics = s.haptics ?? true;
        animations = s.animations ?? true;
        graphics = s.graphics ?? 'high';
        autoMuck = s.autoMuck ?? true;
        fourColor = s.fourColor ?? false;
        betSlider = s.betSlider ?? true;
        autoPostBlinds = s.autoPostBlinds ?? true;
      }
    } catch {
      /* ignore */    // Apply sound + haptics from settings
    setSoundEnabled(sound);
    setHapticsEnabled(haptics);
    }
  });

  function save() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        'settings',
        JSON.stringify({
          sound, music, haptics, animations, graphics,
          autoMuck, fourColor, betSlider, autoPostBlinds,
        }),
      );
    } catch {
      /* igno      setSoundEnabled(sound);
      setHapticsEnabled(haptics);re */
    }
  }

  $: if (typeof window !== 'undefined') save();
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';

  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  type Category = 'all' | 'chips' | 'cards' | 'frames' | 'table';
  type Rarity = 'common' | 'rare' | 'legendary' | 'immortal' | 'arcana' | 'ton';

  let activeCategory: Category = 'all';
  let rarityFilter: Rarity | 'all' = 'all';
  let priceFilter: 'all' | 'low' | 'high' = 'all';

  interface Item {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    category: Category;
    rarity: Rarity;
    priceUsd: number;
    priceTon: number;
    image: string;
    imageBg: string;
    label: string;
  }

  const items: Item[] = [

    { id: 'chip_green',  name: 'Green Chip Pack',  category: 'chips',  rarity: 'rare',      priceUsd: 4.99,  priceTon: 1.25,  image: '/chips-set-hq.png', imageBg: 'chip_green',  label: 'Rare' },
    { id: 'chip_gold',   name: 'Gold Chip Pack',   category: 'chips',  rarity: 'legendary', priceUsd: 19.99, priceTon: 5.00,  image: '/chips-set-hq.png', imageBg: 'chip_gold',   label: 'Legendary' },
    { id: 'chip_purple', name: 'Purple Chip Pack', category: 'chips',  rarity: 'immortal',  priceUsd: 49.99, priceTon: 12.50, image: '/chips-set-hq.png', imageBg: 'chip_purple', label: 'Immortal' },
    { id: 'chip_red',    name: 'Red Chip Pack',    category: 'chips',  rarity: 'arcana',    priceUsd: 99.99, priceTon: 25.00, image: '/chips-set-hq.png', imageBg: 'chip_red',    label: 'Arcana' },

    { id: 'card_dark',   name: 'Dark Deck',        category: 'cards',  rarity: 'immortal',  priceUsd: 6.99,  priceTon: 1.75,  image: '/card-back-dark.png',    imageBg: 'card_dark',    label: 'Immortal' },
    { id: 'frame_royal', name: 'Royal Frame',      category: 'frames', rarity: 'legendary', priceUsd: 9.99,  priceTon: 2.50,  image: '/frame-royal.png',       imageBg: 'frame_royal',  label: 'Legendary' },
    { id: 'frame_epic',  name: 'Epic Frame',       category: 'frames', rarity: 'rare',      priceUsd: 3.99,  priceTon: 1.00,  image: '/frame-epic.png',        imageBg: 'frame_epic',   label: 'Rare' },
    { id: 'table_royal', name: 'Royal Table',      category: 'table',  rarity: 'immortal',  priceUsd: 12.99, priceTon: 3.25,  image: '/table-top.png',         imageBg: 'table_royal',  label: 'Immortal' },
  ];

  const categories: { key: Category; label: string }[] = [
    { key: 'all', label: 'All' },
    { key: 'chips', label: 'Chips' },
    { key: 'cards', label: 'Cards' },
    { key: 'frames', label: 'Frames' },
    { key: 'table', label: 'Table' },
  ];

  const rarityColors: Record<string, string> = {
    common: '#94a3b8',
    rare: '#3b82f6',
    legendary: '#d4af37',
    immortal: '#8b5cf6',
    arcana: '#ef4444',
    ton: '#22d3ee',
  };

  // Chip background positions (for chips-set-hq.png 4├ù3 grid)
  const chipBg: Record<string, string> = {
    chip_blue:   '0% 0%',    // 1 chip
    chip_green:  '33.33% 0%', // 5 chip
    chip_gold:   '66.66% 0%', // 25 chip
    chip_purple: '100% 0%',  // 100 chip
    chip_red:    '0% 50%',   // 500 chip
    chip_ton:    '33.33% 50%', // 1K chip
  };

  $: filtered = items.filter((i) => {
    if (activeCategory !== 'all' && i.category !== activeCategory) return false;
    if (rarityFilter !== 'all' && i.rarity !== rarityFilter) return false;
    if (priceFilter === 'low' && i.priceUsd > 5) return false;
    if (priceFilter === 'high' && i.priceUsd <= 5) return false;
    return true;
  });

  let balanceUsd = 2840;
  let balanceTon = 1.25;

  function getImageStyle(item: Item): string {
    if (item.category === 'chips') {
      const pos = chipBg[item.imageBg] || '0% 0%';
      return `
        background-image: url('${item.image}');
        background-size: 400% 300%;
        background-position: ${pos};
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
      `;
    }
    if (item.category === 'cards') {
      return `
        background-image: url('${item.image}');
        background-size: 55% auto;
        background-position: center;
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
        border-radius: 8px;
      `;
    }
    if (item.category === 'table') {
      return `
        background-image: url('${item.image}');
        background-size: 95% auto;
        background-position: center;
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
      `;
    }
    // frames
    return `
      background-image: url('${item.image}');
      background-size: 70% auto;
      background-position: center;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
    `;
  }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import PokerTable from '../components/PokerTable.svelte';
  import PlayingCard from '../components/PlayingCard.svelte';
  import HandHistoryModal from '../components/HandHistoryModal.svelte';
  import HandReplayModal from '../components/HandReplayModal.svelte';
  import PlayerInfoModal from '../components/PlayerInfoModal.svelte';
  import ChatModal from '../components/ChatModal.svelte';
  import { TableSocketIO, type TableState } from '../lib/socket';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';
  import { t } from '../i18n';
  import { playSound } from '../lib/sounds';
  import { haptic } from '../lib/haptics';

  export let tableId: number = 1;
  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  let socket: TableSocketIO | null = null;
  let gameState: TableState | null = null;
  let connected = false;
  let reconnecting = false;
  let reconnectAttempt = 0;
  let reconnectSynced = false;
  let errorMsg = '';
  let autoActionMsg = '';
  let startingHand = true;
  let showMenu = false;
  let showHandHistory = false;
  let showReplay = false;
  let replayHandId: number | null = null;
  let sittingOut = false;
  let handResult: any = null;
  let showSeedModal = false;
  let nowTick = Date.now();

  // Sound + Haptic triggers
  let lastSoundHandNo = -1;
  let lastSoundCommunityCount = 0;
  let lastSoundWinnersKey = '';

  // ≡ا¤┤ New: player info + chat
  let selectedPlayer: any = null;
  let showPlayerInfo = false;
  let showChat = false;

  let raiseAmount = 0;
  let raiseTouched = false;
  let raiseInput = '0.00';
  let raiseInputFocused = false;

  type PreActionKey = 'check_fold' | 'check' | 'call_any' | 'fold';
  type PreAction = PreActionKey | null;
  let preAction: PreAction = null;
  let lastFireKey: string | null = null;
  let lastEndedHandNo = -1;

  $: myUserId = $auth.user?.id;
  $: mySeat = gameState?.seats?.find((s: any) => s.userId === myUserId) ?? null;
  $: isMyTurn = !!(
    gameState &&
    mySeat &&
    gameState.currentSeat === mySeat.seat &&
    !mySeat.folded &&
    !mySeat.allIn
  );

  $: maxBet = gameState ? Math.max(0, ...gameState.seats.map((s: any) => s.betThisStreet)) : 0;
  $: myBet = mySeat?.betThisStreet ?? 0;
  $: toCall = Math.max(0, maxBet - myBet);
  $: myStack = mySeat?.stack ?? 0;
  $: canCheck = toCall === 0;

  $: minRaiseTo = gameState ? Math.min(maxBet + gameState.minRaise, myStack + myBet) : 0;
  $: hardMax = myStack + myBet;
  $: canRaise = isMyTurn && hardMax > maxBet && hardMax >= minRaiseTo;

  $: timeRemaining =
    gameState && gameState.turnStartedAt
      ? Math.max(0, (gameState.turnBaseLimit ?? 30) - (nowTick - gameState.turnStartedAt) / 1000)
      : 30;

  $: canUseBank =
    isMyTurn &&
    mySeat &&
    mySeat.timeBankRemaining > 0 &&
    !gameState?.turnBankActive &&
    timeRemaining <= 5;

  $: if (isMyTurn && !raiseTouched) raiseAmount = Math.min(minRaiseTo, hardMax);
  $: if (!isMyTurn) {
    raiseTouched = false;
  }
  $: if (raiseAmount < minRaiseTo) raiseAmount = minRaiseTo;
  $: if (raiseAmount > hardMax) raiseAmount = hardMax;

  $: if (!raiseInputFocused) raiseInput = raiseAmount.toFixed(2);

  $: raisePercent =
    hardMax > minRaiseTo ? ((raiseAmount - minRaiseTo) / (hardMax - minRaiseTo)) * 100 : 100;

  $: myAvatarId = ($auth.user as any)?.avatar_id || 'spade';

  $: variantLabel =
    gameState?.variant === 'omaha4'
      ? 'Omaha 4'
      : gameState?.variant === 'omaha5'
        ? 'Omaha 5'
        : "NL Hold'em";
  $: blindsLabel = gameState
    ? `$${fmt(gameState.smallBlind)} / $${fmt(gameState.bigBlind)}`
    : '$0.50 / $1.00';
  $: isTournament = !!gameState?.tournamentId;
  $: isFinalTable = isTournament && gameState?.tournamentTableNumber === 1000;
  $: tableTitle = isTournament ? 'Tournament' : 'Cash Game';
  $: seatCount = gameState?.seats?.length ?? 0;

  const PRE_ACTIONS: {
    key: PreActionKey;
    label: string;
    paths: string[];
    color: string;
  }[] = [
    {
      key: 'check_fold',
      label: 'Check/Fold',
      color: '#3b82f6',
      paths: ['M3 12l4 4 9-9', 'M15 4l5 5', 'M20 4l-5 5'],
    },
    {
      key: 'check',
      label: 'Check',
      color: '#10b981',
      paths: ['M5 12l4 4 10-10'],
    },
    {
      key: 'call_any',
      label: 'Call Any',
      color: '#8b5cf6',
      paths: [
        'M3 5.5C3 4.1 4.1 3 5.5 3h2.3c.5 0 .9.3 1 .8l.7 3.2c.1.4 0 .8-.4 1L7.5 9.5c1 2 2.5 3.5 4.5 4.5l1.5-1.6c.2-.3.6-.4 1-.3l3.2.7c.5.1.8.5.8 1v2.3c0 1.4-1.1 2.5-2.5 2.5C8.6 19.1 3 13.4 3 5.5z',
      ],
    },
    {
      key: 'fold',
      label: 'Fold',
      color: '#ef4444',
      paths: ['M6 6l12 12', 'M18 6L6 18'],
    },
  ];

  $: showPreActions =
    gameState &&
    !startingHand &&
    !handResult &&
    !sittingOut &&
    !isMyTurn &&
    mySeat &&
    !mySeat.folded &&
    !mySeat.allIn &&
    gameState.phase !== 'showdown' &&
    gameState.phase !== 'waiting';

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function suitChar(s: string): 'ظآب' | 'ظآح' | 'ظآخ' | 'ظآث' {
    if (s === 's') return 'ظآب';
    if (s === 'h') return 'ظآح';
    if (s === 'd') return 'ظآخ';
    return 'ظآث';
  }

  function connect() {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (!token) {
      errorMsg = 'no_token';
      return;
    }

    socket = new TableSocketIO(tableId, token);
    socket.on((evt) => {
      if (evt.type === 'connected') {
        connected = true;
        reconnecting = false;
      } else if (evt.type === 'disconnected') {
        connected = false;
        reconnecting = true;
        errorMsg = 'Reconnectingظخ';
      } else if (evt.type === 'reconnecting') {
        reconnecting = true;
        reconnectAttempt = (evt as any).attempt || 0;
      } else if (evt.type === 'reconnected') {
        reconnecting = false;
        reconnectSynced = true;
        autoActionMsg = 'ظ£à Reconnected';
        setTimeout(() => {
          autoActionMsg = '';
          reconnectSynced = false;
        }, 2000);
      } else if (evt.type === 'state') {
        const newState = evt.state;

        // ===== SOUND + HAPTIC: New hand ظْ deal sound =====
        if (newState?.handNo && newState.handNo !== lastSoundHandNo) {
          lastSoundHandNo = newState.handNo;
          lastSoundCommunityCount = 0;
          playSound('deal', 0.5);
          haptic.light();
        }

        // ===== SOUND: Community cards appeared ظْ flip =====
        const ccCount = newState?.community?.length || 0;
        if (ccCount > lastSoundCommunityCount) {
          lastSoundCommunityCount = ccCount;
          playSound('card-flip', 0.5);
          haptic.light();
        }

        gameState = newState;
        startingHand = false;
      } else if (evt.type === 'hand_result') {
        handResult = evt.result;
        gameState = evt.state;
        resetPreAction();

        // ===== SOUND + HAPTIC: Win/lose =====
        const winners = evt.result?.winners || [];
        const winnersKey = winners.join(',');
        if (winnersKey && winnersKey !== lastSoundWinnersKey) {
          lastSoundWinnersKey = winnersKey;
          const mySeatNow = evt.state?.seats?.find((s: any) => s.userId === myUserId);
          const iWon = mySeatNow && winners.includes(mySeatNow.seat);

          if (iWon) {
            playSound('win', 0.6);
            haptic.success();
          } else {
            playSound('lose', 0.5);
            haptic.error();
          }
        }

        setTimeout(() => {
          handResult = null;
        }, 7000);
      } else if (evt.type === 'error') {
        errorMsg = evt.message;
        setTimeout(() => {
          errorMsg = '';
        }, 3000);
      }
    });
    socket.connect();
  }

  onMount(() => {
    connect();
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      nowTick = Date.now();
    }, 500);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  });

  onDestroy(() => {
    if (socket) socket.close();
  });

  function resetPreAction() {
    preAction = null;
    lastFireKey = null;
  }

  $: if (
    gameState?.handNo &&
    gameState.handNo !== lastEndedHandNo &&
    gameState.winners &&
    gameState.winners.length > 0
  ) {
    lastEndedHandNo = gameState.handNo;
    resetPreAction();
  }

  function tryFirePreAction() {
    if (!isMyTurn || !preAction || sittingOut) return;
    if (!socket) return;

    const action = preAction;
    const handNo = gameState?.handNo ?? -1;

    const fireKey = `${handNo}-${gameState?.community?.length || 0}-${gameState?.currentSeat}`;
    if (lastFireKey === fireKey) return;
    lastFireKey = fireKey;

    let sent = false;

    if (action === 'fold') {
      socket.action('FOLD', 0);
      autoActionMsg = 'ظ£ù Fold (pre-action)';
      sent = true;
    } else if (action === 'check') {
      if (canCheck) {
        socket.action('CHECK', 0);
        autoActionMsg = 'ظ£ô Check (pre-action)';
        sent = true;
      } else {
        autoActionMsg = 'ظأبي╕ Cannot check';
        setTimeout(() => {
          autoActionMsg = '';
        }, 1500);
      }
    } else if (action === 'check_fold') {
      if (canCheck) {
        socket.action('CHECK', 0);
        autoActionMsg = 'ظ£ô Check (pre-action)';
        sent = true;
      } else {
        socket.action('FOLD', 0);
        autoActionMsg = 'ظ£ù Fold (pre-action)';
        sent = true;
      }
    } else if (action === 'call_any') {
      if (canCheck) {
        socket.action('CHECK', 0);
        autoActionMsg = 'ظ£ô Check (pre-action)';
        sent = true;
      } else if (myStack > 0) {
        socket.action('CALL', 0);
        autoActionMsg = '≡اôئ Call (pre-action)';
        sent = true;
      } else {
        socket.action('FOLD', 0);
        autoActionMsg = 'ظ£ù Fold (no chips)';
        sent = true;
      }
    }

    if (sent) {
      preAction = null;
      lastFireKey = null;
      setTimeout(() => {
        autoActionMsg = '';
      }, 2000);
    }
  }

  $: if (isMyTurn && preAction && !sittingOut) {
    setTimeout(tryFirePreAction, 150);
  }

  function setPreAction(pa: PreActionKey) {
    if (preAction === pa) {
      preAction = null;
      lastFireKey = null;
    } else {
      preAction = pa;
      lastFireKey = null;
      autoActionMsg = `≡ا» ${pa.replace('_', '/')} armed`;
      setTimeout(() => {
        autoActionMsg = '';
      }, 1500);
    }
  }

  function doAction(action: 'FOLD' | 'CHECK' | 'CALL', amount = 0) {
    if (!socket || !isMyTurn) return;
    resetPreAction();
    socket.action(action, amount);

    // ===== SOUND + HAPTIC per action =====
    if (action === 'FOLD') {
      playSound('button', 0.4);
      haptic.light();
    } else if (action === 'CALL') {
      playSound('chip', 0.5);
      haptic.medium();
    } else {
      // CHECK
      playSound('check', 0.5);
      haptic.light();
    }
  }

  function doRaise() {
    if (!canRaise) return;
    resetPreAction();
    socket?.action('RAISE', Math.floor(raiseAmount * 100) / 100);

    // ===== SOUND + HAPTIC: Raise =====
    playSound('chip', 0.6);
    haptic.medium();
  }

  function setRaise(v: number) {
    raiseTouched = true;
    raiseAmount = Math.min(Math.max(v, minRaiseTo), hardMax);
  }

  function commitRaiseInput() {
    raiseInputFocused = false;
    const v = parseFloat(raiseInput);
    if (!isNaN(v) && v > 0) setRaise(v);
    raiseInput = raiseAmount.toFixed(2);
  }

  function handleRaiseKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      raiseInput = raiseAmount.toFixed(2);
      (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
    }
  }

  function potRaise() {
    if (!gameState) return;
    const potTotal = (gameState.pot ?? 0) + maxBet - myBet;
    setRaise(Math.min(potTotal, hardMax));
  }

  function fractionRaise(f: number) {
    if (!gameState) return;
    const potTotal = (gameState.pot ?? 0) + maxBet - myBet;
    setRaise(Math.min(maxBet + potTotal * f, hardMax));
  }

  function allIn() {
    setRaise(hardMax);
  }

  function useTimeBank() {
    if (!socket || !canUseBank) return;
    socket.useTimeBank();
  }

  function toggleMenu() {
    showMenu = !showMenu;
  }

  function doSitOut() {
    sittingOut = true;
    showMenu = false;
    resetPreAction();
    autoActionMsg = '≡اْج Sitting out';
    setTimeout(() => {
      autoActionMsg = '';
    }, 2500);
  }

  function doSitIn() {
    sittingOut = false;
    showMenu = false;
    autoActionMsg = 'ظû╢ي╕ Back in action';
    setTimeout(() => {
      autoActionMsg = '';
    }, 2000);
  }

  function leaveTable() {
    showMenu = false;
    if (!confirm('Leave this table?')) return;
    socket?.leaveTable();
    setTimeout(() => onBack(), 200);
  }

  function openPlayerInfo(userId: number) {
    const s = gameState?.seats?.find((x: any) => x.userId === userId);
    if (!s) return;
    selectedPlayer = {
      ...s,
      dealer: gameState?.dealerSeat === s.seat,
    };
    showPlayerInfo = true;
  }

  function mutePlayer(userId: number) {
    autoActionMsg = '≡ا¤ç Player muted';
    setTimeout(() => {
      autoActionMsg = '';
    }, 1500);
  }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';

  export let initialVariant: string = 'all';
  export let initialMode: 'all' | 'free' | 'real' = 'all';
  export let onOpenTable: (id: number) => void = () => {};

  let tables: any[] = [];
  let loading = true;
  let error = '';
  let filterMode: 'all' | 'free' | 'real' = initialMode;
  let filterVariant: string = initialVariant;

  let pollTimer: any = null;

  async function loadTables() {
    try {
      const res = await api.tables();
      if (res.ok && res.data) tables = res.data.tables;
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  onMount(() => {
    loadTables();
    pollTimer = setInterval(loadTables, 4000);
  });

  onDestroy(() => {
    if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer);
  });

  $: filtered = tables.filter((tbl) => {
    const okMode = filterMode === 'all' || tbl.mode === filterMode;
    const okVariant = filterVariant === 'all' || tbl.variant === filterVariant;
    return okMode && okVariant;
  });

  function variantSuit(v: string): string {
    if (v === 'holdem') return '/cards/suit-spade.png';
    if (v === 'omaha4') return '/cards/suit-diamond.png';
    if (v === 'omaha5') return '/cards/suit-club.png';
    return '/cards/suit-heart.png';
  }

  function variantLabel(v: string): string {
    if (v === 'holdem') return "Hold'em";
    if (v === 'omaha4') return 'Omaha 4';
    if (v === 'omaha5') return 'Omaha 5';
    return v;
  }

  function variantColor(v: string): string {
    if (v === 'holdem') return '#3b82f6';
    if (v === 'omaha4') return '#ef4444';
    if (v === 'omaha5') return '#10b981';
    return '#d4af37';
  }

  // ===== Seat availability =====
  function seatStatus(live: number, max: number): {
    color: string;
    label: string;
    pct: number;
  } {
    const safeMax = Math.max(1, max);
    const pct = Math.min(100, (live / safeMax) * 100);
    if (live >= safeMax) return { color: '#ef4444', label: 'Full', pct };
    if (live >= safeMax - 1) return { color: '#f59e0b', label: 'Almost full', pct };
    if (live === 0) return { color: '#6b7280', label: 'Empty', pct };
    return { color: '#10b981', label: 'Open', pct };
  }
</script>

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/routes/TournamentDetail.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';
  import { getRealtime, realtimeConnected, TOURNAMENT_EVENT_RE } from '../lib/realtime';
  import { pushNotif } from '../lib/notifications';
  import Avatar from '../components/Avatar.svelte';

  export let tournamentId: number;
  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};
  export let onOpenTable: (tid: number, virtualTableId: number) => void = () => {};

  let t: any = null;
  let loading = true;
  let error = '';
  let acting = false;
  let toast = '';
  let pausedBanner = false;

  async function doPause() {
    if (!confirm('Pause this tournament?')) return;
    acting = true;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/tournaments/${tournamentId}/pause`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('admin_secret') || ''}`,
        },
        body: '{}',
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) { toast = 'ظ╕ي╕ Paused'; await load(); }
      else toast = 'ظإî ' + (data.error || 'failed');
    } catch (e: any) { toast = 'ظإî ' + e.message; }
    finally { acting = false; setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3000); }
  }

  async function doResume() {
    acting = true;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/tournaments/${tournamentId}/resume`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('admin_secret') || ''}`,
        },
        body: '{}',
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) { toast = 'ظû╢ي╕ Resumed'; await load(); }
      else toast = 'ظإî ' + (data.error || 'failed');
    } catch (e: any) { toast = 'ظإî ' + e.message; }
    finally { acting = false; setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3000); }
  }
  let pollTimer: any = null;

  $: myUserId = $auth.user?.id;
  $: isRegistered = t?.players?.some((p: any) => p.userId === myUserId && p.status === 'active') || false;
  $: myTournamentPlayer = t?.players?.find((p: any) => p.userId === myUserId);
  $: myVirtualTableId = myTournamentPlayer?.virtualTableId ?? null;
  $: canGoToTable =
    !!myVirtualTableId &&
    (t?.status === 'running' || t?.status === 'final_table') &&
    myTournamentPlayer?.status === 'active';
  $: canRegister = t && (t.status === 'registering' || t.status === 'scheduled');
  $: canStart = t && canRegister && t.registeredCount >= t.minPlayers;

  function fmt(n: any, d = 2): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(d)).toFixed(d);
  }

  function fmtDate(iso: string | null): string {
    if (!iso) return 'ظ¤';
    try {
      return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('en-US', {
        month: 'short', day: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
      });
    } catch { return 'ظ¤'; }
  }

  function statusColor(status: string): string {
    if (status === 'running') return '#10b981';
    if (status === 'final_table') return '#d4af37';
    if (status === 'registering') return '#22d3ee';
    if (status === 'scheduled') return '#8b5cf6';
    if (status === 'finished') return '#6b7280';
    if (status === 'paused') return '#f59e0b';
    return '#ef4444';
  }

  function statusLabel(status: string): string {
    return status.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase();
  }

  async function load() {
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.getTournament(tournamentId);
      if (res.ok && res.data) t = res.data;
      else error = res.error || 'not_found';
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  function onAnyEvent(event: string, ...args: any[]): void {
    const m = event.match(TOURNAMENT_EVENT_RE);
    if (!m) return;
    const tid = Number(m[1]);
    if (tid !== tournamentId) return;
    const type = m[2];
    const data = args[0] ?? {};

    if (type === 'level') {
      pushNotif({
        icon: 'ظس',
        title: `Level ${data.level ?? '?'} ظ¤ blinds up`,
        message: `${data.sb ?? '?'}/${data.bb ?? '?'}${data.ante ? ` ┬╖ ante ${data.ante}` : ''}`,
        color: '#f4c95d',
      });
    } else if (type === 'elimination') {
      pushNotif({
        icon: '≡اْ',
        title: `${data.displayName ?? 'Player'} eliminated`,
        message: `Position #${data.finalPosition ?? '?'}`,
        color: '#ef4444',
      });
    } else if (type === 'final_table') {
      pushNotif({ icon: '≡ا', title: 'FINAL TABLE', color: '#f4c95d' });
    } else if (type === 'finished') {
      pushNotif({ icon: '≡ا', title: 'Tournament finished', color: '#10b981' });
    }
    load();
  }

  onMount(() => {
    load();
    pollTimer = setInterval(load, 15000);
    return () => { if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer); };
  });

  $: if ($realtimeConnected) {
    const s = getRealtime();
    if (s) { s.offAny(onAnyEvent); s.onAny(onAnyEvent); }
  }

  onDestroy(() => {
    const s = getRealtime();
    if (s) s.offAny(onAnyEvent);
  });

  async function doRegister() {
    acting = true;
    try {
      const res = await api.registerTournament(tournamentId);
      if (res.ok) { toast = 'ظ£à Registered!'; await load(); }
      else toast = 'ظإî ' + (res.error || 'failed');
    } catch (e: any) { toast = 'ظإî ' + e.message; }
    finally { acting = false; setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3000); }
  }

  async function doUnregister() {
    acting = true;
    try {
      const res = await api.unregisterTournament(tournamentId);
      if (res.ok) { toast = 'ظري╕ Unregistered'; await load(); }
      else toast = 'ظإî ' + (res.error || 'failed');
    } catch (e: any) { toast = 'ظإî ' + e.message; }
    finally { acting = false; setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3000); }
  }

  async function doStart() {
    if (!confirm('Start this tournament now?')) return;
    acting = true;
    try {
      const res = await api.startTournament(tournamentId);
      if (res.ok) { toast = '≡اأ Started!'; await load(); }
      else toast = 'ظإî ' + (res.error || 'failed');
    } catch (e: any) { toast = 'ظإî ' + e.message; }
    finally { acting = false; setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3000); }
  }
</script>

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/routes/Tournaments.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { getRealtime, realtimeConnected, TOURNAMENT_EVENT_RE } from '../lib/realtime';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';

  export let onOpenTournament: (id: number) => void = () => {};

  type Filter = 'all' | 'running' | 'registering' | 'scheduled' | 'finished';

  let filter: Filter = 'all';
  let tournaments: any[] = [];
  let loading = true;
  let error = '';
  let pollTimer: any = null;

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function fmtTime(iso: string | null): string {
    if (!iso) return 'ظ¤';
    try {
      const d = new Date(iso);
      const diff = d.getTime() - Date.now();
      if (diff < 0) return 'Started';
      const min = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
      if (min < 60) return `in ${min}m`;
      const h = Math.floor(min / 60);
      return `in ${h}h`;
    } catch { return 'ظ¤'; }
  }

  const FILTERS: { key: Filter; label: string; color: string }[] = [
    { key: 'all', label: 'All', color: '#d4af37' },
    { key: 'running', label: 'Live', color: '#10b981' },
    { key: 'registering', label: 'Open', color: '#22d3ee' },
    { key: 'scheduled', label: 'Upcoming', color: '#8b5cf6' },
    { key: 'finished', label: 'Finished', color: '#6b7280' },
  ];

  async function load() {
    error = '';
    try {
      const statusParam = filter === 'all' ? undefined : filter;
      const res = await api.listTournaments({ status: statusParam });
      if (res.ok && res.data) tournaments = res.data.tournaments || [];
      else error = res.error || 'failed';
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; }
    finally { loading = false; }
  }

  function onAnyEvent(event: string): void {
    if (TOURNAMENT_EVENT_RE.test(event)) load();
  }

  onMount(() => {
    load();
    pollTimer = setInterval(load, 20000);
    return () => { if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer); };
  });

  $: if ($realtimeConnected) {
    const s = getRealtime();
    if (s) { s.offAny(onAnyEvent); s.onAny(onAnyEvent); }
  }

  onDestroy(() => {
    const s = getRealtime();
    if (s) s.offAny(onAnyEvent);
  });

  function statusColor(status: string): string {
    if (status === 'running') return '#10b981';
    if (status === 'final_table') return '#d4af37';
    if (status === 'registering') return '#22d3ee';
    if (status === 'scheduled') return '#8b5cf6';
    if (status === 'finished') return '#6b7280';
    return '#ef4444';
  }

  function statusLabel(status: string): string {
    if (status === 'final_table') return 'FINAL';
    return status.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase();
  }

  function formatLabel(t: any): string {
    const map: Record<string, string> = { sng: 'SNG', mtt: 'MTT', freeroll: 'FREE', satellite: 'SAT' };
    return map[t.format] || t.format.toUpperCase();
  }

  // Featured = running tournament with biggest prize pool
  $: featured = tournaments
    .filter((t) => t.status === 'running' || t.status === 'final_table')
    .sort((a, b) => Number(b.totalPrizePool) - Number(a.totalPrizePool))[0] || null;

  $: others = featured ? tournaments.filter((t) => t.id !== featured.id) : tournaments;
</script>

<div class="pb-44 lg:pb-8">

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/routes/Wallet.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';

  let activeTab: 'deposit' | 'withdraw' | 'history' = 'deposit';
  let balance = 0;
  let freeChips = 0;
  let tonStats = { deposited: 0, withdrawn: 0 };
  let hotWalletReady = false;
  let depositInfo: any = null;
  let history: any = { tonTransactions: [], ledgerTransactions: [] };
  let loading = true;
  let error = '';
  let successMsg = '';
  let withdrawAmount = '';
  let withdrawAddress = '';
  let withdrawing = false;
  let walletConnected = false;
  let walletAddress: string | null = null;

  function fmt(n: any, decimals = 2): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(decimals)).toFixed(decimals);
  }

  async function loadAll() {
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const [bal, dep, hist] = await Promise.all([
        api.walletBalance(),
        api.walletDepositInfo(),
        api.walletHistory(),
      ]);
      if (bal.ok && bal.data) {
        balance = bal.data.balance || 0;
        freeChips = bal.data.freeChips || 0;
        tonStats = bal.data.ton || { deposited: 0, withdrawn: 0 };
        hotWalletReady = !!bal.data.hotWalletReady;
      }
      if (dep.ok && dep.data) depositInfo = dep.data;
      if (hist.ok && hist.data) history = hist.data;
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; }
    finally { loading = false; }
  }

  async function connectWallet() {
    try {
      const tc = (window as any).tonConnectUI;
      if (!tc) { error = 'TON Connect not loaded'; setTimeout(() => (error = ''), 3000); return; }
      if (tc.connected) await tc.disconnect();
      else await tc.openModal();
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; setTimeout(() => (error = ''), 3000); }
  }

  async function doWithdraw() {
    if (!withdrawAddress || !withdrawAmount) return;
    const amt = parseFloat(withdrawAmount);
    if (isNaN(amt) || amt <= 0) { error = 'Invalid amount'; setTimeout(() => (error = ''), 3000); return; }
    withdrawing = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.walletWithdraw(amt, withdrawAddress);
      if (res.ok) {
        successMsg = `ظ£à Withdraw submitted: ${amt} TON`;
        withdrawAmount = '';
        withdrawAddress = '';
        setTimeout(() => (successMsg = ''), 4000);
        await loadAll();
      } else { error = res.error || 'withdraw_failed'; setTimeout(() => (error = ''), 4000); }
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; setTimeout(() => (error = ''), 4000); }
    finally { withdrawing = false; }
  }

  function copyDepositAddress() {
    if (depositInfo?.depositAddress) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(depositInfo.depositAddress);
      successMsg = '≡اôï Address copied';
      setTimeout(() => (successMsg = ''), 2000);
    }
  }

  function copyMemo() {
    if (depositInfo?.memo) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(depositInfo.memo);
      successMsg = '≡اôï Memo copied';
      setTimeout(() => (successMsg = ''), 2000);
    }
  }

  function useConnectedAddress() {
    if (walletAddress) withdrawAddress = walletAddress;
  }

  onMount(async () => {
    await loadAll();
    const tc = (window as any).tonConnectUI;
    if (tc) {
      tc.onStatusChange((wallet: any) => {
        if (wallet) { walletConnected = true; walletAddress = wallet.account?.address || null; }
        else { walletConnected = false; walletAddress = null; }
      });
      if (tc.connected) {
        walletConnected = true;
        walletAddress = tc.account?.address || null;
      }
    }
  });

  $: tonNet = tonStats.deposited - tonStats.withdrawn;
</script>

            <span class="text-[9px] px-2 py-1 rounded-full font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider"
                  style="background: {sc}25; color: {sc}; border: 1px solid {sc}60;">
              {tx.status}
            </span>
          </div>
        {/each}
      </div>
    {/if}
  {/if}

  {#if successMsg}
    <div class="fixed top-20 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40 rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 max-w-[90%]"
         style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6,78,59,0.95), rgba(5,150,105,0.9)); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.6);">
      <p class="text-xs font-extrabold text-emerald-100">{successMsg}</p>
    </div>
  {/if}

========== FILE: apps/mini-app/src/stores/auth.ts ==========
import { writable } from 'svelte/store';
import { api } from '../lib/api';

export interface User {
  id: number;
  telegram_id: number;
  username: string;
  display_name: string;
  language: string;
  avatar_id?: string;
}

export interface AuthState {
  user: User | null;
  wallet: { balance_usd: string; locked_usd: string } | null;
  freeChips: { chips: string; total_hands: number } | null;
  token: string | null;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

function createAuthStore() {
  const { subscribe, set, update } = writable<AuthState>({
    user: null,
    wallet: null,
    freeChips: null,
    token: null,
    loading: true,
    error: null,
  });

  return {
    subscribe,

    async init() {
      update((s) => ({ ...s, error: null }));

      const tg = (window as any).Telegram?.WebApp;
      if (tg) {
        tg.ready();
        tg.expand();
        if (tg.setHeaderColor) tg.setHeaderColor('#0a0e1a');
        if (tg.setBackgroundColor) tg.setBackgroundColor('#0a0e1a');
      }

      const tgInitData = tg?.initData;
      let authPayload: string;

      if (tgInitData && tgInitData.length > 0) {
        authPayload = tgInitData;
      } else {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const urlUid = params.get('uid');
        const urlName = params.get('name');

        let devUid: number;
        let devName: string;

        if (urlUid) {
          devUid = Number(urlUid);
          devName = urlName || `User${devUid}`;
          localStorage.setItem('dev_uid', String(devUid));
          localStorage.setItem('dev_name', devName);
        } else {
          const storedUid = localStorage.getItem('dev_uid');
          if (storedUid) {
            devUid = Number(storedUid);
            devName = localStorage.getItem('dev_name') || `User${devUid}`;
          } else {
            devUid = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000);
            devName = `User${devUid}`;
            localStorage.setItem('dev_uid', String(devUid));
            localStorage.setItem('dev_name', devName);
          }
        }

        const userJson = JSON.stringify({
          id: devUid,
          first_name: devName,
          username: devName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, ''),
          language_code: 'en',
        });

        authPayload = `user=${encodeURIComponent(userJson)}&auth_date=9999999999&hash=dev`;
      }

      try {
        const res = await api.authTelegram(authPayload);
        if (!res.ok || !res.data) {
          update((s) => ({ ...s, loading: false, error: res.error || 'auth_failed' }));
          return false;
        }

        localStorage.setItem('token', res.data.token);
        update((s) => ({ ...s, token: res.data!.token, user: res.data!.user }));

        await this.refresh();
        return true;
      } catch (e: any) {
        update((s) => ({ ...s, loading: false, error: e.message || 'network_error' }));
        return false;
      }
    },

    async refresh() {
      const res = await api.me();
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        update((s) => ({
          ...s,
          user: res.data!.user,
          wallet: res.data!.wallet,
          freeChips: res.data!.free_chips,
          loading: false,
          error: null,
        }));
      } else {
        update((s) => ({ ...s, loading: false, error: res.error || 'refresh_failed' }));
      }
    },

    logout() {
      localStorage.removeItem('token');
      localStorage.removeItem('dev_uid');
      localStorage.removeItem('dev_name');
      set({ user: null, wallet: null, freeChips: null, token: null, loading: false, error: null });
    },
  };
}

export const auth = createAuthStore();

import { writable } from 'svelte/store';
import { CARD_THEMES, type CardTheme } from '../lib/card-themes';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'card_theme';

const stored: CardTheme =
  (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined'
    ? (localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) as CardTheme | null)
    : null) || 'classic';

export const cardTheme = writable<CardTheme>(stored);

// Persist whenever it changes
if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
  cardTheme.subscribe((v) => {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, v);
  });
}

-- Add late_reg_level to tournaments
-- Standard MTT uses "levels" not "minutes" for late registration.
-- 0 = no late reg (registration closes at start)

ALTER TABLE tournaments
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS late_reg_level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

COMMENT ON COLUMN tournaments.late_reg_level IS 'Last level at which new players can register. 0 = no late reg.';

-- Index for the auto-close check
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tournaments_late_reg
  ON tournaments (status, current_level)
  WHERE status IN ('running', 'final_table');

    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_name = 'tournament_players' AND column_name = 'eliminated_by'

-- Broadcast messages from admin to players
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_broadcasts (
  id            SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  title         TEXT NOT NULL,
  message       TEXT NOT NULL,
  target        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all',  -- all | active | banned | high_risk
  severity      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info', -- info | warning | success | danger
  created_by    BIGINT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_broadcasts_created
  ON admin_broadcasts (created_at DESC);

-- Read receipts
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_broadcast_reads (
  broadcast_id  INT NOT NULL REFERENCES admin_broadcasts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id       BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  read_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  PRIMARY KEY (broadcast_id, user_id)
);

-- Panel settings (key-value)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_settings (
  key           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value         JSONB NOT NULL,
  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

  ('cash_games_open',   'true'::jsonb),
  ('tournaments_open',  'true'::jsonb),
  ('deposits_open',     'true'::jsonb),
  ('withdrawals_open',  'true'::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_actions (
  id            SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  action        TEXT NOT NULL,              -- ban_user | unban_user | adjust_wallet | broadcast | ...
  target_type   TEXT,                       -- user | tournament | table | broadcast | setting
  target_id     TEXT,
  payload       JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  admin_ref     TEXT,                       -- "ADMIN_SECRET" or admin user_id
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_actions_created
  ON admin_actions (created_at DESC);

-- System account for admin wallet adjustments
INSERT INTO accounts (code, type) VALUES
  ('SYSTEM_ADMIN_ADJUST', 'system')
ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

import { Pool } from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
