import type { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { gameManager } from './game-manager.js';

const ADMIN_SECRET = process.env.ADMIN_SECRET ?? 'admin_dev_secret';

function isAdmin(req: any): boolean {
  const auth = req.headers.authorization;
  return auth === `Bearer ${ADMIN_SECRET}`;
}

export async function registerOverviewRoutes(app: FastifyInstance, db: Pool) {
  // ============================================================
  // OVERVIEW ظ¤ all-in-one dashboard
  // ============================================================
  app.get('/api/admin/overview', async (req, reply) => {
    if (!isAdmin(req)) return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'forbidden' });

    const [
      usersStats,
      tablesStats,
      tourneyStats,
      anticheatStats,
      walletStats,
      recentUsers,
    ] = await Promise.all([
      // Users
      db.query(`
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)::int AS total,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_banned = TRUE)::int AS banned,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours')::int AS new_24h,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days')::int AS new_7d,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_score >= 65)::int AS high_risk
        FROM users
      `),
      // Tables
      db.query(`
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)::int AS total,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_active = TRUE)::int AS active,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE variant = 'holdem')::int AS holdem,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE variant = 'omaha4')::int AS omaha4,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE variant = 'omaha5')::int AS omaha5
        FROM poker_tables
      `),
      // Tournaments
      db.query(`
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)::int AS total,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'running')::int AS running,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'registering')::int AS registering,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'scheduled')::int AS scheduled,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'finished')::int AS finished,
          COALESCE(SUM(total_rake), 0)::numeric AS total_rake
        FROM tournaments
      `),
      // Anti-cheat
      db.query(`
        SELECT
          (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM suspicious_events WHERE resolved = FALSE) AS unresolved,
          (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM player_risk WHERE score >= 65) AS high_risk
      `),
      // Wallet
      db.query(`
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)::int AS total_wallets,
          COALESCE(SUM(balance_usd), 0)::numeric AS total_balance,
          COALESCE(AVG(balance_usd), 0)::numeric AS avg_balance
        FROM wallets
      `),
      // Recent users
      db.query(`
        SELECT id, display_name, username, created_at, is_banned, risk_score
        FROM users
        ORDER BY created_at DESC
        LIMIT 5
      `),
    ]);

    const rooms = gameManager.getRooms();
    let livePlayers = 0;
    let liveHands = 0;
    for (const room of rooms) {
      livePlayers += room.players.size;
      liveHands += room.game.state.handNo;
    }

    const u = usersStats.rows[0];
    const t = tablesStats.rows[0];
    const to = tourneyStats.rows[0];
    const a = anticheatStats.rows[0];
    const w = walletStats.rows[0];

    return {
      users: {
        total: u.total,
        banned: u.banned,
        new24h: u.new_24h,
        new7d: u.new_7d,
        highRisk: u.high_risk,
      },
      tables: {
        total: t.total,
        active: t.active,
        byVariant: {
          holdem: t.holdem,
          omaha4: t.omaha4,
          omaha5: t.omaha5,
        },
      },
      tournaments: {
        total: to.total,
        running: to.running,
        registering: to.registering,
        scheduled: to.scheduled,
        finished: to.finished,
        totalRake: Number(to.total_rake),
      },
      anticheat: {
        unresolved: a.unresolved,
        highRisk: a.high_risk,
      },
      wallet: {
        totalWallets: w.total_wallets,
        totalBalance: Number(w.total_balance),
        avgBalance: Number(w.avg_balance),
      },
      live: {
        rooms: rooms.length,
        players: livePlayers,
        hands: liveHands,
      },
      recentUsers: recentUsers.rows.map((r) => ({
        id: Number(r.id),
        displayName: r.display_name,
        username: r.username,
        createdAt: r.created_at,
        isBanned: r.is_banned,
        riskScore: r.risk_score,
      })),
    };
  });

  // ============================================================
  // LIVE MONITOR ظ¤ rooms in real-time
  // ============================================================
  app.get('/api/admin/live', async (req, reply) => {
    if (!isAdmin(req)) return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'forbidden' });

    const rooms = gameManager.getRooms();
    const list = rooms.map((room: any) => {
      const players: any[] = [];
      for (const [, p] of room.players) {
        players.push({
          userId: p.userId,
          displayName: p.displayName,
          stack: p.stack,
          folded: p.folded,
          allIn: p.allIn,
        });
      }
      return {
        tableId: room.tableId,
        tableName: room.tableName ?? null,
        phase: room.game?.state?.phase ?? 'waiting',
        handNo: room.game?.state?.handNo ?? 0,
        pot: room.game?.state?.pot ?? 0,
        currentSeat: room.game?.state?.currentSeat ?? null,
        players,
      };
    });

    return { rooms: list };
  });
}

========== FILE: apps/server/src/season-manager.ts ==========
import { Pool } from 'pg';

export interface SeasonRow {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  start_at: Date;
  end_at: Date;
  status: 'active' | 'finished';
  prize_pool: string;
}

export class SeasonManager {
  constructor(private db: Pool) {}

  computePoints(position: number, players: number, buyIn: number): number {
    if (!position || position <= 0 || !players || players <= 0) return 0;
    const base = (10 * Math.sqrt(players)) / Math.sqrt(position);
    const multiplier = 1 + Math.log10(Math.max(0, buyIn) + 1);
    const points = Math.round(base * multiplier);
    return Math.max(0, points);
  }

  async ensureActiveSeason(): Promise<SeasonRow> {
    const existing = await this.db.query(`SELECT * FROM seasons WHERE status = 'active' LIMIT 1`);
    if (existing.rows.length > 0) {
      const s = existing.rows[0];
      if (new Date(s.end_at) < new Date()) {
        await this.db.query(`UPDATE seasons SET status = 'finished' WHERE id = $1`, [s.id]);
        return this.createCurrentMonthSeason();
      }
      return s;
    }
    return this.createCurrentMonthSeason();
  }

  private async createCurrentMonthSeason(): Promise<SeasonRow> {
    const now = new Date();
    const y = now.getUTCFullYear();
    const m = now.getUTCMonth();
    const startAt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0));
    const endAt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m + 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0));
    const monthName = startAt.toLocaleString('en-US', {
      month: 'long',
      year: 'numeric',
      timeZone: 'UTC',
    });

    const res = await this.db.query(
      `INSERT INTO seasons (name, start_at, end_at, status)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'active')
       RETURNING *`,
      [monthName, startAt, endAt],
    );
    console.log(`[season] ≡اùôي╕ created season "${monthName}" (#${res.rows[0].id})`);
    return res.rows[0];
  }

  async list(): Promise<SeasonRow[]> {
    const res = await this.db.query(`SELECT * FROM seasons ORDER BY start_at DESC LIMIT 24`);
    return res.rows;
  }

  async leaderboard(seasonId: number, limit: number = 100): Promise<any[]> {
    const res = await this.db.query(
      `SELECT
         te.user_id,
         u.display_name,
         u.avatar_id,
         SUM(te.points_earned)::int AS total_points,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE te.final_position = 1)::int AS wins,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE te.payout_amount > 0 OR te.status = 'qualified')::int AS itm_count,
         COUNT(*)::int AS tournaments_played,
         COALESCE(SUM(te.payout_amount), 0) AS total_won
       FROM tournament_entries te
       JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = te.tournament_id
       JOIN users u ON u.id = te.user_id
       WHERE t.season_id = $1
         AND t.status = 'finished'
         AND te.status IN ('cashed', 'won', 'qualified', 'eliminated')
       GROUP BY te.user_id, u.display_name, u.avatar_id
       HAVING SUM(te.points_earned) > 0
       ORDER BY total_points DESC, wins DESC, tournaments_played ASC
       LIMIT $2`,
      [seasonId, limit],
    );

    return res.rows.map((r, i) => ({
      rank: i + 1,
      userId: r.user_id,
      displayName: r.display_name,
      avatarId: r.avatar_id,
      points: r.total_points,
      wins: r.wins,
      itm: r.itm_count,
      played: r.tournaments_played,
      won: Number(r.total_won),
    }));
  }

  async myRank(
    seasonId: number,
    userId: number,
  ): Promise<{ rank: number | null; points: number; wins: number; played: number } | null> {
    const res = await this.db.query(
      `WITH agg AS (
         SELECT
           te.user_id,
           SUM(te.points_earned)::int AS points,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE te.final_position = 1)::int AS wins,
           COUNT(*)::int AS played
         FROM tournament_entries te
         JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = te.tournament_id
         WHERE t.season_id = $1
           AND t.status = 'finished'
           AND te.status IN ('cashed', 'won', 'qualified', 'eliminated')
         GROUP BY te.user_id
       ),
       ranked AS (
         SELECT
           user_id, points, wins, played,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY points DESC, wins DESC, played ASC) AS rank
         FROM agg
         WHERE points > 0
       )
       SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE user_id = $2`,
      [seasonId, userId],
    );
    if (res.rows.length === 0) {
      return { rank: null, points: 0, wins: 0, played: 0 };
    }
    const r = res.rows[0];
    return {
      rank: Number(r.rank),
      points: Number(r.points),
      wins: Number(r.wins),
      played: Number(r.played),
    };
  }
}

========== FILE: apps/server/src/settings-routes.ts ==========
import type { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { Pool } from 'pg';

const ADMIN_SECRET = process.env.ADMIN_SECRET ?? 'admin_dev_secret';

function isAdmin(req: any): boolean {
  const auth = req.headers.authorization;
  return auth === `Bearer ${ADMIN_SECRET}`;
}

const ALLOWED_KEYS = [
  'maintenance_mode',
  'registration_open',
  'cash_games_open',
  'tournaments_open',
  'deposits_open',
  'withdrawals_open',
];

export async function registerSettingsRoutes(app: FastifyInstance, db: Pool) {
  // ============================================================
  // GET ALL SETTINGS
  // ============================================================
  app.get('/api/admin/settings', async (req, reply) => {
    if (!isAdmin(req)) return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'forbidden' });
    const res = await db.query(
      `SELECT key, value, updated_at FROM admin_settings ORDER BY key`,
    );
    const out: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const r of res.rows) {
      out[r.key] = { value: r.value, updatedAt: r.updated_at };
    }
    return { settings: out };
  });

  // ============================================================
  // UPDATE ONE OR MANY SETTINGS
  // ============================================================
  app.post<{
    Body: Record<string, any>;
  }>('/api/admin/settings', async (req, reply) => {
    if (!isAdmin(req)) return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'forbidden' });

    const body = req.body ?? {};
    const entries = Object.entries(body);
    if (entries.length === 0) {
      return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'empty_body' });
    }

    // ┘┘é╪╖ ┌ر┘█î╪»┘ç╪د█î ┘à╪ش╪د╪▓
    const invalid = entries.filter(([k]) => !ALLOWED_KEYS.includes(k));
    if (invalid.length > 0) {
      return reply
        .code(400)
        .send({ error: 'invalid_keys', keys: invalid.map(([k]) => k) });
    }

    const client = await db.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');

      for (const [key, value] of entries) {
        await client.query(
          `INSERT INTO admin_settings (key, value, updated_at)
           VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb, NOW())
           ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE
             SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = NOW()`,
          [key, JSON.stringify(value)],
        );
      }

      await client.query(
        `INSERT INTO admin_actions (action, target_type, target_id, payload)
         VALUES ('update_settings', 'setting', 'batch', $1)`,
        [JSON.stringify(body)],
      );

      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (e: any) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      return reply.code(500).send({ error: e.message });
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }

    return { ok: true, updated: entries.map(([k]) => k) };
  });

  // ============================================================
  // PUBLIC ظ¤ game status (╪ذ╪▒╪د█î ┘┘à╪د█î╪┤ maintenance mode ╪ذ┘ç ╪ذ╪د╪▓█î┌ر┘)
  // ============================================================
  app.get('/api/status', async () => {
    const res = await db.query(
      `SELECT key, value FROM admin_settings WHERE key IN
       ('maintenance_mode','registration_open','cash_games_open',
        'tournaments_open','deposits_open','withdrawals_open')`,
    );
    const out: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    for (const r of res.rows) {
      out[r.key] = r.value === true || r.value === 'true';
    }
    return { status: out };
  });

  // ============================================================
  // ADMIN ظ¤ action log
  // ============================================================
  app.get<{ Querystring: { limit?: string } }>(
    '/api/admin/actions',
    async (req, reply) => {
      if (!isAdmin(req)) return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'forbidden' });
      const limit = Math.min(Number(req.query.limit) || 50, 200);
      const res = await db.query(
        `SELECT id, action, target_type, target_id, payload, created_at
         FROM admin_actions
         ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $1`,
        [limit],
      );
      return {
        actions: res.rows.map((r) => ({
          id: Number(r.id),
          action: r.action,
          targetType: r.target_type,
          targetId: r.target_id,
          payload: r.payload,
          createdAt: r.created_at,
        })),
      };
    },
  );
}

========== FILE: apps/server/src/socket-server.ts ==========
import { Server as SocketIOServer } from 'socket.io';
import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { verifyToken } from './auth.js';
import { gameManager } from './game-manager.js';
import { CommandQueue } from './command-queue.js';
import { ErrorCode } from './errors.js';
import { recordIp, recordDevice, analyzeUser } from './anti-cheat.js';

const JWT_SECRET = process.env.JWT_SECRET ?? 'dev_secret_change_me';
// ============================================================
// Chat
// ============================================================
interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  userId: number;
  displayName: string;
  avatarId: string;
  text: string;
  isEmoji: boolean;
  timestamp: number;
}

const CHAT_MAX_LENGTH = 200;
const CHAT_HISTORY_SIZE = 50;
const CHAT_COOLDOWN_MS = 1500;
const VIRTUAL_TABLE_THRESHOLD = 1_000_000;

export function setupSocketServer(io: SocketIOServer, db: Pool): void {
  console.log('[socket.io] server setup');
  const commandQueue = new CommandQueue(db);
    // ============================================================
  // Chat state (in-memory, per table)
  // ============================================================
  const chatHistory = new Map<number, ChatMessage[]>();
  const lastChatAt = new Map<string, number>(); // socketId ظْ last message time

  io.use(async (socket, next) => {
    try {
      const token = socket.handshake.auth?.token;
      if (!token) return next(new Error(ErrorCode.AUTH_REQUIRED));

      const payload = verifyToken(token, JWT_SECRET);
      if (!payload) return next(new Error(ErrorCode.INVALID_SESSION));

      const userId = payload.uid;

      const uCheck = await db.query(
        'SELECT is_banned, display_name, avatar_id FROM users WHERE id = $1',
        [userId],
      );
      if (uCheck.rows.length === 0) return next(new Error('user_not_found'));
      if (uCheck.rows[0].is_banned) return next(new Error('banned'));

      (socket as any).userId = userId;
      (socket as any).displayName = uCheck.rows[0].display_name;
      (socket as any).avatarId = uCheck.rows[0].avatar_id || 'king';

      const ip = socket.handshake.address || 'unknown';
      await recordIp(db, userId, ip);
      const deviceHash = socket.handshake.auth?.device;
      if (deviceHash) await recordDevice(db, userId, deviceHash);

      next();
    } catch (e: any) {
      next(new Error(e.message));
    }
  });

  io.on('connection', (socket) => {
    const userId = (socket as any).userId;
    const displayName = (socket as any).displayName;
    const avatarId = (socket as any).avatarId || 'king';

    console.log(`[socket.io] connected: ${displayName} (${socket.id})`);

    socket.on(
      'table:join',
      async (
        data: { tableId: number; lastHandNo?: number; lastSequence?: number },
        ack?: Function,
      ) => {
        try {
          const tableId = Number(data?.tableId);
          if (!tableId) return ack?.({ ok: false, code: ErrorCode.TABLE_NOT_FOUND });

          const isTournament = tableId >= VIRTUAL_TABLE_THRESHOLD;

          let table: any;

          if (isTournament) {
            const existingRoom = gameManager.getRoom(tableId);
            if (!existingRoom) {
              console.warn(
                `[socket] tournament table ${tableId} not found in gameManager (stale client)`,
              );
              return ack?.({
                ok: false,
                code: 'STALE_TOURNAMENT',
                hint: 'This table no longer exists. Please go back to Tournaments list.',
              });
            }
            table = {
              id: tableId,
              variant: existingRoom.variant,
              mode: 'real',
              speed: existingRoom.speed,
              blinds: existingRoom.blinds,
              rake_pct: 0,
            };
            console.log(
              `[socket] ${displayName} joining tournament table ${tableId} (T#${existingRoom.tournamentId} table ${existingRoom.tournamentTableNumber})`,
            );
          } else {
            const tableRes = await db.query('SELECT * FROM poker_tables WHERE id = $1', [tableId]);
            if (tableRes.rows.length === 0)
              return ack?.({ ok: false, code: ErrorCode.TABLE_NOT_FOUND });
            table = tableRes.rows[0];
          }

          const room = gameManager.joinRoom({
            tableId,
            userId,
            displayName,
            socketId: socket.id,
            tableConfig: table,
          });

          socket.join(`table:${tableId}`);

          const sync = gameManager.resync(
            tableId,
            userId,
            data?.lastHandNo ?? null,
            data?.lastSequence ?? null,
          );

          ack?.({
            ok: true,
            tableId,
            userId,
            displayName,
            playersInRoom: room.players.size,
            syncType: sync.syncType,
            currentHandNo: sync.currentHandNo,
            currentSequence: sync.currentSequence,
          });

          gameManager.broadcastState(tableId, io);

          socket.to(`table:${tableId}`).emit('table:player_joined', {
            userId,
            displayName,
            total: room.players.size,
          });

          // ≡ا¤┤ Auto-start logic
          setTimeout(async () => {
            const r = gameManager.getRoom(tableId);
            if (!r) return;
            if (r.game.state.phase !== 'waiting') return;

            const connected = [...r.players.values()].filter((p) => !!p.socketId).length;
            const total = r.players.size;

            if (isTournament) {
              if (connected >= 2) {
                console.log(
                  `[hand] ≡ا tournament table ${tableId}: starting with ${connected}/${total} connected`,
                );
                try {
                  await gameManager.startHand(tableId, io);
                } catch (e) {
                  console.error('[hand] tournament startHand error:', e);
                }
              } else {
                console.log(
                  `[hand] tournament table ${tableId}: waiting (${connected}/${total} connected)`,
                );
              }
            } else {
              if (connected >= 2) {
                try {
                  await gameManager.startHand(tableId, io);
                } catch (e) {
                  console.error('[hand] startHand error:', e);
                }
              }
            }
          }, 1500);

          setTimeout(() => analyzeUser(db, userId, tableId), 2000);
        } catch (e: any) {
          console.error('[socket] join error', e);
          ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'JOIN_FAILED', error: e.message });
        }
      },
    );

    socket.on(
      'table:action',
      async (data: { action: string; amount?: number; commandId?: string }, ack?: Function) => {
        try {
          const action = String(data?.action ?? '').toUpperCase();
          const amount = Number(data?.amount ?? 0);
          const commandId = data?.commandId || `${socket.id}_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}`;

          if (!['FOLD', 'CHECK', 'CALL', 'RAISE', 'BET'].includes(action)) {
            return ack?.({ ok: false, code: ErrorCode.INVALID_ACTION });
          }

          const result = await commandQueue.run(commandId, userId, 'table_action', () =>
            gameManager.act(socket.id, action, amount, io),
          );

          ack?.(result);
        } catch (e: any) {
          console.error('[socket] action error', e);
          ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', error: e.message });
        }
      },
    );

    socket.on('table:time_bank', async (data: any, ack?: Function) => {
      try {
        const result = await gameManager.useTimeBank(socket.id, io);
        ack?.(result);
      } catch (e: any) {
        ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', error: e.message });
      }
    });

    socket.on(
      'table:resync',
      async (
        data: { tableId: number; lastHandNo: number; lastSequence: number },
        ack?: Function,
      ) => {
        try {
          const tableId = Number(data?.tableId);
          const sync = gameManager.resync(
            tableId,
            userId,
            data?.lastHandNo ?? null,
            data?.lastSequence ?? null,
          );
          ack?.({ ok: true, ...sync });
          gameManager.broadcastState(tableId, io);
        } catch (e: any) {
          ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', error: e.message });
        }
      },
    );
    // ============================================================
    // CHAT ظ¤ send message
    // ============================================================
    socket.on(
      'table:chat',
      async (data: { text: string; isEmoji?: boolean }, ack?: Function) => {
        try {
          const ctx = gameManager.getPlayerBySocket(socket.id);
          if (!ctx) return ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_IN_TABLE' });

          const tableId = ctx.room.tableId;
          const text = String(data?.text ?? '').trim();

          if (!text) return ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'EMPTY' });
          if (text.length > CHAT_MAX_LENGTH) return ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'TOO_LONG' });

          // Anti-spam
          const now = Date.now();
          const lastAt = lastChatAt.get(socket.id) ?? 0;
          if (now - lastAt < CHAT_COOLDOWN_MS) {
            return ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'RATE_LIMIT' });
          }
          lastChatAt.set(socket.id, now);

          const msg: ChatMessage = {
            id: `${now}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
            userId,
            displayName: displayName,
            avatarId: avatarId,
            text,
            isEmoji: !!data?.isEmoji || text.length <= 4,
            timestamp: now,
          };

          // Save to history
          const hist = chatHistory.get(tableId) ?? [];
          hist.push(msg);
          while (hist.length > CHAT_HISTORY_SIZE) hist.shift();
          chatHistory.set(tableId, hist);

          // Broadcast to all players at table
          io.to(`table:${tableId}`).emit('table:chat_message', msg);

          ack?.({ ok: true, messageId: msg.id });
        } catch (e: any) {
          ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', error: e.message });
        }
      },
    );

    // ============================================================
    // CHAT ظ¤ request history
    // ============================================================
    socket.on('table:chat_history', async (_data: any, ack?: Function) => {
      try {
        const ctx = gameManager.getPlayerBySocket(socket.id);
        if (!ctx) return ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_IN_TABLE' });
        const tableId = ctx.room.tableId;
        const hist = chatHistory.get(tableId) ?? [];
        ack?.({ ok: true, messages: hist });
      } catch (e: any) {
        ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', error: e.message });
      }
    });
    socket.on('table:leave', async (data: any, ack?: Function) => {
      try {
        const ctx = gameManager.getPlayerBySocket(socket.id);
        if (ctx) socket.leave(`table:${ctx.room.tableId}`);
        gameManager.leaveRoom(socket.id);
        ack?.({ ok: true });
      } catch (e: any) {
        ack?.({ ok: false, code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', error: e.message });
      }
    });

    socket.on('disconnect', (reason) => {      lastChatAt.delete(socket.id);
      console.log(`[socket.io] disconnected: ${displayName} (${socket.id}) - ${reason}`);
      const ctx = gameManager.getPlayerBySocket(socket.id);
      if (ctx) {
        const tableId = ctx.room.tableId;
        socket.to(`table:${tableId}`).emit('table:player_left', {
          userId,
          total: Math.max(0, ctx.room.players.size - 1),
        });
      }
      gameManager.leaveRoom(socket.id);
    });

    socket.on('ping:app', (cb?: Function) => {
      cb?.({ pong: true, time: Date.now() });
    });
  });
}

========== FILE: apps/server/src/table-manager.ts ==========
import type { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { verifyToken } from './auth.js';
import { gameManager } from './game-manager.js';

const ADMIN_SECRET = process.env.ADMIN_SECRET ?? 'admin_dev_secret';
const JWT_SECRET = process.env.JWT_SECRET ?? 'dev_secret_change_me';

function isAdmin(req: any): boolean {
  const auth = req.headers.authorization;
  return auth === `Bearer ${ADMIN_SECRET}`;
}

export async function registerTableManagerRoutes(app: FastifyInstance, db: Pool) {
  app.get('/api/tables/live', async () => {
    const res = await db.query(
      `SELECT id, name, variant, mode, speed, blinds, min_buyin, max_buyin, rake_pct, seats, is_active, created_at
       FROM poker_tables WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY id`,
    );
    const tables = res.rows.map((t: any) => {
      const room = gameManager.getRoom(t.id);
      return {
        ...t,
        live_players: room ? room.players.size : 0,
        live_phase: room?.game?.state?.phase ?? 'waiting',
        live_hand_no: room?.game?.state?.handNo ?? 0,
      };
    });
    return { tables };
  });

  app.get('/api/admin/tables', async (req, reply) => {
    if (!isAdmin(req)) return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'forbidden' });
    const res = await db.query(
      `SELECT id, name, variant, mode, speed, blinds, min_buyin, max_buyin, rake_pct, seats, is_active, created_at
       FROM poker_tables ORDER BY is_active DESC, id`,
    );
    const tables = res.rows.map((t: any) => {
      const room = gameManager.getRoom(t.id);
      return {
        ...t,
        live_players: room ? room.players.size : 0,
        live_phase: room?.game?.state?.phase ?? null,
        live_hand_no: room?.game?.state?.handNo ?? 0,
      };
    });
    return { tables };
  });

  app.post<{ Body: Record<string, any> }>('/api/admin/tables', async (req, reply) => {
    if (!isAdmin(req)) return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'forbidden' });
    const b = req.body ?? {};
    if (!b.name || !b.variant || !b.mode) return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'missing_fields' });
    if (!['holdem', 'omaha4', 'omaha5'].includes(b.variant))
      return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'invalid_variant' });
    if (!['free', 'real'].includes(b.mode)) return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'invalid_mode' });
    if (b.small_blind <= 0 || b.big_blind <= 0)
      return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'invalid_blinds' });
    if (b.big_blind < b.small_blind) return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'bb_lt_sb' });
    if (b.seats < 2 || b.seats > 10) return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'invalid_seats' });
    const blinds = {
      sb: Number(b.small_blind),
      bb: Number(b.big_blind),
      ante: Number(b.ante ?? 0),
    };
    const inserted = await db.query(
      `INSERT INTO poker_tables (name, variant, mode, speed, blinds, min_buyin, max_buyin, rake_pct, seats, is_active)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, TRUE) RETURNING *`,
      [
        b.name,
        b.variant,
        b.mode,
        b.speed ?? 'regular',
        JSON.stringify(blinds),
        Number(b.min_buyin ?? 0),
        Number(b.max_buyin ?? 0),
        Number(b.rake_pct ?? 0.03),
        Number(b.seats ?? 6),
      ],
    );
    return { ok: true, table: inserted.rows[0] };
  });

  app.patch<{ Params: { id: string }; Body: any }>('/api/admin/tables/:id', async (req, reply) => {
    if (!isAdmin(req)) return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'forbidden' });
    const { id } = req.params;
    const b: Record<string, any> = req.body ?? {};
    const existing = await db.query('SELECT * FROM poker_tables WHERE id = $1', [id]);
    if (existing.rows.length === 0) return reply.code(404).send({ error: 'table_not_found' });
    const cur = existing.rows[0];
    const blinds =
      b.small_blind !== undefined || b.big_blind !== undefined || b.ante !== undefined
        ? {
            sb: Number(b.small_blind ?? cur.blinds.sb),
            bb: Number(b.big_blind ?? cur.blinds.bb),
            ante: Number(b.ante ?? cur.blinds.ante ?? 0),
          }
        : cur.blinds;
    const fields: string[] = [];
    const values: any[] = [];
    let idx = 1;
    const setField = (name: string, val: any) => {
      fields.push(`${name} = $${idx++}`);
      values.push(val);
    };
    if (b.name !== undefined) setField('name', b.name);
    if (b.variant !== undefined) setField('variant', b.variant);
    if (b.mode !== undefined) setField('mode', b.mode);
    if (b.speed !== undefined) setField('speed', b.speed);
    if (b.small_blind !== undefined || b.big_blind !== undefined || b.ante !== undefined)
      setField('blinds', JSON.stringify(blinds));
    if (b.min_buyin !== undefined) setField('min_buyin', Number(b.min_buyin));
    if (b.max_buyin !== undefined) setField('max_buyin', Number(b.max_buyin));
    if (b.rake_pct !== undefined) setField('rake_pct', Number(b.rake_pct));
    if (b.seats !== undefined) setField('seats', Number(b.seats));
    if (b.is_active !== undefined) setField('is_active', Boolean(b.is_active));
    if (fields.length === 0) return { ok: true, table: cur };
    values.push(id);
    const q = `UPDATE poker_tables SET ${fields.join(', ')} WHERE id = $${idx} RETURNING *`;
    const updated = await db.query(q, values);
    return { ok: true, table: updated.rows[0] };
  });

  app.post<{ Params: { id: string }; Body: { active: boolean } }>(
    '/api/admin/tables/:id/toggle',
    async (req, reply) => {
      if (!isAdmin(req)) return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'forbidden' });
      const { id } = req.params;
      const { active } = req.body ?? {};
      const updated = await db.query(
        'UPDATE poker_tables SET is_active = $1 WHERE id = $2 RETURNING *',
        [Boolean(active), id],
      );
      if (updated.rows.length === 0) return reply.code(404).send({ error: 'table_not_found' });
      return { ok: true, table: updated.rows[0] };
    },
  );

  app.delete<{ Params: { id: string } }>('/api/admin/tables/:id', async (req, reply) => {
    if (!isAdmin(req)) return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'forbidden' });
    const { id } = req.params;
    const room = gameManager.getRoom(Number(id));
    if (room && room.players.size > 0) return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'table_has_players' });
    await db.query('DELETE FROM poker_tables WHERE id = $1', [id]);
    return { ok: true };
  });

  app.get('/api/admin/tables/stats', async (req, reply) => {
    if (!isAdmin(req)) return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'forbidden' });
    const total = await db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM poker_tables');
    const active = await db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM poker_tables WHERE is_active = TRUE');
    const rooms = gameManager.getRooms();
    let liveHands = 0;
    let livePlayers = 0;
    for (const room of rooms) {
      liveHands += room.game.state.handNo;
      livePlayers += room.players.size;
    }
    return {
      totalTables: Number(total.rows[0].c),
      activeTables: Number(active.rows[0].c),
      liveRooms: rooms.length,
      liveHands,
      livePlayers,
    };
  });
}

import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { Pool } from 'pg';
import * as path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
dotenv.config({ path: path.resolve(__dirname, '../../.env') });

const DATABASE_URL = process.env.DATABASE_URL || 'postgres://poker:pokerpass@localhost:5432/poker';

// ===== Copy of LedgerService =====
class LedgerService {
  constructor(private db: Pool) {}

  async record(input: any): Promise<any> {
    const sum = input.entries.reduce((s: number, e: any) => s + e.amount, 0);
    if (Math.abs(sum) > 0.001) {
      return { ok: false, error: `Ledger mismatch: sum=${sum}` };
    }
    if (input.entries.length === 0) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'No entries' };
    }

    if (input.idempotencyKey) {
      const existing = await this.db.query('SELECT result FROM idempotency_keys WHERE key = $1', [
        input.idempotencyKey,
      ]);
      if (existing.rows.length > 0) {
        return { ok: true, duplicate: true, transactionId: existing.rows[0].result?.transactionId };
      }
    }

    const client = await this.db.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');

      const ids = [...new Set(input.entries.map((e: any) => e.accountId))].sort(
        (a: any, b: any) => a - b,
      );
      for (const id of ids) {
        await client.query('SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE', [id]);
      }

      const txRes = await client.query(
        `INSERT INTO transactions (kind, ref, meta, status, user_id, idempotency_key, amount, completed_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'completed', $4, $5, $6, NOW())
         RETURNING id`,
        [
          input.kind,
          input.ref || null,
          JSON.stringify(input.meta || {}),
          input.userId || null,
          input.idempotencyKey || null,
          Math.abs(
            input.entries.reduce((s: number, e: any) => s + (e.amount > 0 ? e.amount : 0), 0),
          ),
        ],
      );
      const txId = txRes.rows[0].id;

      for (const entry of input.entries) {
        await client.query(
          `INSERT INTO entries (tx_id, account_id, amount, currency) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'USD')`,
          [txId, entry.accountId, entry.amount],
        );
      }

      for (const entry of input.entries) {
        const accRes = await client.query('SELECT owner_user_id FROM accounts WHERE id = $1', [
          entry.accountId,
        ]);
        const userId = accRes.rows[0]?.owner_user_id;
        if (userId) {
          await client.query(
            `UPDATE wallets SET balance_usd = balance_usd + $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = $2`,
            [entry.amount, userId],
          );
        }
      }

      if (input.idempotencyKey) {
        await client.query(
          `INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, user_id, result) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)`,
          [input.idempotencyKey, input.userId || null, JSON.stringify({ transactionId: txId })],
        );
      }

      await client.query('COMMIT');
      return { ok: true, transactionId: txId };
    } catch (e: any) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      return { ok: false, error: e.message };
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  }

  async getBalance(accountId: number): Promise<number> {
    const res = await this.db.query(
      `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)::numeric AS balance FROM entries WHERE account_id = $1`,
      [accountId],
    );
    return Number(res.rows[0].balance);
  }

  async getAccountId(code: string): Promise<number | null> {
    const res = await this.db.query('SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE code = $1', [code]);
    return res.rows[0]?.id ?? null;
  }

  async getUserAccountId(userId: number): Promise<number | null> {
    return this.getAccountId(`USER_${userId}`);
  }

  async getHistory(userId: number, limit = 50, offset = 0) {
    const accountId = await this.getUserAccountId(userId);
    if (!accountId) return [];
    const res = await this.db.query(
      `SELECT e.id, e.amount, e.currency, e.created_at, t.kind, t.ref, t.meta, t.status
       FROM entries e JOIN transactions t ON t.id = e.tx_id
       WHERE e.account_id = $1 ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3`,
      [accountId, limit, offset],
    );
    return res.rows;
  }
}

async function main() {
  const db = new Pool({ connectionString: DATABASE_URL });
  const ledger = new LedgerService(db);

  console.log('Testing Ledger Service\n');

  const userRes = await db.query('SELECT id FROM users LIMIT 1');
  if (userRes.rows.length === 0) {
    console.log('No users found');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const userId = userRes.rows[0].id;
  console.log(`Using test user: id=${userId}`);

  const userAcc = await ledger.getUserAccountId(userId);
  const depositAcc = await ledger.getAccountId('SYSTEM_DEPOSITS');
  const rakeAcc = await ledger.getAccountId('HOUSE_RAKE');

  console.log(`User account: ${userAcc}`);
  console.log(`Deposits account: ${depositAcc}`);
  console.log(`Rake account: ${rakeAcc}\n`);

  if (!userAcc || !depositAcc || !rakeAcc) {
    console.log('Missing accounts');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log('TEST 1: Deposit $100');
  const r1 = await ledger.record({
    kind: 'DEPOSIT',
    userId,
    entries: [
      { accountId: depositAcc, amount: -100 },
      { accountId: userAcc, amount: +100 },
    ],
    idempotencyKey: `dep_${userId}_001`,
  });
  console.log('Result:', r1);
  const bal1 = await ledger.getBalance(userAcc);
  console.log(`Balance after deposit: $${bal1}\n`);

  console.log('TEST 2: Duplicate deposit (should be ignored)');
  const r2 = await ledger.record({
    kind: 'DEPOSIT',
    userId,
    entries: [
      { accountId: depositAcc, amount: -100 },
      { accountId: userAcc, amount: +100 },
    ],
    idempotencyKey: `dep_${userId}_001`,
  });
  console.log('Result:', r2);
  const bal2 = await ledger.getBalance(userAcc);
  console.log(`Balance (should be same): $${bal2}\n`);

  console.log('TEST 3: Rake $3');
  const r3 = await ledger.record({
    kind: 'RAKE',
    entries: [
      { accountId: userAcc, amount: -3 },
      { accountId: rakeAcc, amount: +3 },
    ],
    idempotencyKey: `rake_${Date.now()}`,
  });
  console.log('Result:', r3);
  const bal3 = await ledger.getBalance(userAcc);
  console.log(`Balance after rake: $${bal3}`);
  const rakeBal = await ledger.getBalance(rakeAcc);
  console.log(`Rake account: $${rakeBal}\n`);

  console.log('TEST 4: Invalid transaction (sum != 0)');
  const r4 = await ledger.record({
    kind: 'DEPOSIT',
    entries: [
      { accountId: userAcc, amount: +100 },
      { accountId: depositAcc, amount: -50 },
    ],
  });
  console.log('Result (should fail):', r4, '\n');

  console.log('TEST 5: Transaction history');
  const history = await ledger.getHistory(userId, 10);
  console.log(`Found ${history.length} transactions:`);
  for (const h of history) {
    console.log(`  ${h.kind}: ${h.amount} @ ${h.created_at}`);
  }

  await db.end();
  console.log('\nAll tests complete');
}

========== FILE: apps/server/src/ton.ts ==========
import { TonClient, WalletContractV4, internal } from '@ton/ton';
import { mnemonicToPrivateKey } from '@ton/crypto';
import { Address, toNano, fromNano } from '@ton/core';
import { getHttpEndpoint } from '@orbs-network/ton-access';

const TON_NETWORK = (process.env.TON_NETWORK || 'testnet') as 'mainnet' | 'testnet';
const TON_API_KEY = process.env.TON_API_KEY || '';
const TON_HOT_MNEMONIC = process.env.TON_HOT_WALLET_MNEMONIC || '';
const TON_MIN_DEPOSIT = Number(process.env.TON_MIN_DEPOSIT || 0.5);

export class TonAdapter {
  private client: TonClient | null = null;
  private wallet: any = null;
  private walletAddress: string | null = null;

  async init(): Promise<void> {
    // ≡ا¤┤ Resolve endpoint via ton-access
    try {
      const endpoint = await getHttpEndpoint({
        network: TON_NETWORK,
        ...(TON_API_KEY ? { apikey: TON_API_KEY } : {}),
      });
      console.log(`[ton] using endpoint: ${endpoint}`);

      this.client = new TonClient({ endpoint });
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('[ton] endpoint resolution failed:', e.message);
      // Fallback to toncenter
      const fallback =
        TON_NETWORK === 'mainnet'
          ? 'https://toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC'
          : 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';
      console.warn(`[ton] falling back to ${fallback}`);
      this.client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: fallback,
        ...(TON_API_KEY ? { apiKey: TON_API_KEY } : {}),
      });
    }

    // ≡ا¤┤ Load hot wallet
    if (!TON_HOT_MNEMONIC) {
      console.warn('[ton] no hot wallet mnemonic ظ¤ withdrawals disabled');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const words = TON_HOT_MNEMONIC.trim().split(/\s+/);
      const key = await mnemonicToPrivateKey(words);
      const wallet = WalletContractV4.create({
        publicKey: key.publicKey,
        workchain: 0,
      });
      this.wallet = { contract: wallet, key };
      this.walletAddress = wallet.address.toString({
        bounceable: false,
        testOnly: TON_NETWORK !== 'mainnet',
      });
      console.log(`[ton] hot wallet: ${this.walletAddress}`);
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('[ton] hot wallet init failed:', e.message);
    }
  }

  getHotWalletAddress(): string | null {
    return this.walletAddress;
  }

  async sendTon(toAddress: string, amountTon: number, memo?: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.wallet) throw new Error('hot_wallet_not_initialized');
    if (!this.client) throw new Error('client_not_initialized');

    const contract = this.client.open(this.wallet.contract);
    const seqno = await contract.getSeqno();

    const transfer = await contract.createTransfer({
      seqno,
      secretKey: this.wallet.key.secretKey,
      messages: [
        internal({
          to: Address.parse(toAddress),
          value: toNano(amountTon.toString()),
          bounce: false,
          body: memo || '',
        }),
      ],
    });

    await contract.send(transfer);
    return transfer.hash().toString('hex');
  }

  async getBalance(address: string): Promise<number> {
    if (!this.client) return 0;
    try {
      const balance = await this.client.getBalance(Address.parse(address));
      return Number(fromNano(balance));
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('[ton] getBalance failed:', e.message);
      return 0;
    }
  }

  getMinDeposit(): number {
    return TON_MIN_DEPOSIT;
  }

  isReady(): boolean {
    return !!this.wallet && !!this.client;
  }
}

export const tonAdapter = new TonAdapter();

import { Pool } from 'pg';

export type TournamentStatus =

export class TournamentManager {
  private ledger: LedgerService;
  private blindService: BlindStructureService;
  private tournaments: Map<number, Tournament> = new Map();
  private io: any = null;

    private seasons: SeasonManager;

constructor(private db: Pool) {
